about: The catalogue of every entity and interaction in bongbong and the sound each needs (docs/sound-system-prd.md section 4.11). Seeded from BB-199's map; kept by the sound-audit skill. Each cue's `manifest` ties it to the cue in audio/cues.toml that plays it.

domains.title: Weapons and combat
domains.summary: Covered the seven standard weapons (cannon with twin barrels and per-chassis calibre, laser, plasma, M134 minigun, seeker missiles, flamethrower stream, grenades), the fire dispatch and its ammo, cooldowns and recoil, every hit resolution in hits.rs/resolve_projectiles/resolve_lasers by target and Material, ricochets, glances, shield deflections and breaks, shell collisions, spall, shots through portals, and combat.rs (hurt_tank, knock, Game::blast with BB-188 friendly fire, rams, wrecks, cook-offs). The event log is good at impacts (Hit carries position, cause and Material) but poor at launches: Fired is one per trigger pull, so a twin barrel's second shell, every minigun round and every missile tube have no event, and the minigun's Fired comes 0.1 s before its first round. The most surprising holes are that Event::Hit never says who fired (no hit marker, no friendly-fire cue), that Event::Ricochet lumps a shell clanging off iron, a drum deflection and a bullet glancing off a hull into one payload-less event, that MissileLocked never travels online and is also missing from NOT_SENT, and that grenade bounces, near misses, pass-overs and bullet hits on aircraft happen with no event at all. To tell the 12 cannons apart, a sound looks the tank up by Fired's slot and reads Tank::row (TankState.row online): tank_damage_factor (0.75 to 1.60) is the calibre, tank_mass_factor the body, twin_gun() the double crack, and the shell sheet row (2/0/1 standard, 7/8 super) survives on the wire in ShotState.variant.

domains.title: Special weapons and air support
domains.summary: Mapped the six BB-36 special weapons (sonic hammer, EMP, gauss rail, FPV swarm, rod from god, gravity well), air support (helicopter, jet) and their shared machinery (tell, charge, disabled state, knock/skid, air targets, zones, the AI hook): 27 entities, 92 interactions, 30 gaps. What surprised me: most of what these weapons do that you could hear has no event at all. Wind-ups are NOT_SENT, charge stages (full, overcharged, the vent warning) are only state, and nothing is logged when a drone commits its dive, the EMP kills a missile, an enemy reboots, the lamps go out at night, or a bullet hits the helicopter without downing it. The same goes for the loops: the drone buzz, the halo hum, rotor and jet flybys, the well's pull, the rod's beam and countdown. The online picture is tricky: a client's own SonicBlast, EmpPulse, RailSlug, DroneLaunched and RodCalled are removed from game.events, but the room's Fired arrives late, and WellAnchored and ChargeEnded are drawn early and then logged again. A sound system has to hook the predictor's PressShow and skip its own seat's room events. Design holes: the rod's fall and the jet's bombs have no flight time, so there is no moment for an incoming whistle; the lock-on warnings (rail lane, drone lock, rod designator) are drawn only off-screen; nothing signals a special running dry or coming back online. BB-102's cue sheet came from the Event enum and had one charge hum, so it missed all of this, plus every air-support cue.

domains.title: World and environment
domains.summary: Covered every tile material and how it chips, chunks, cages, collapses, burns and dies; drums, fuses, chained and launched blasts and oil pools; ground fire, burning timber, embers and the aftermath's smoulder and haze; grass, ground surfaces, water, fords, ice, mud and rubble; every sky (rain, storm lightning, snow, sandstorm gusts, the always-on grass wind, night/dusk/fog/heat haze, nightfall); the volcano cycle, lava bombs and lava; lamp posts, lanterns and training doors; portals; the three defence towers and the bio slush's globs and ooze; supply crates, their air drop, collection by kind, breaking and cooking off; the range board, fish, woods and gates. What surprised me: most of the world's soundscape is state, not events (fire, lava, volcano stages, lightning, gusts, wind, smoulder), but nearly all of it is either on the wire or a pure function of the round clock, so a sample_world works on a replica too. The holes are elsewhere: several ignitions and every drum fuse happen with no event, the towers' heading, tesla charge and burning are not on the wire at all (a replica never runs tower_phase) and the bio slush's globs, ooze and slimed hulls are missing from the snapshot entirely. Chained drum cascades and fire spread are the storms to cap, and several moments fire two events at once (a drum's ObstacleDestroyed plus Blast, a flame-lit cell's FireStarted plus Ignited). BB-102's sheet had rain and wind loops only; it missed the fire crackle bed, fuse hiss, water and wading, lava and the volcano's rumble and eruption, thunder, sandstorm gust fronts, the tesla charge whine, the gun tower's servo, portal hum and lamp buzz.

domains.title: Tanks, bongs, AI and the round
domains.summary: Covered the tanks as vehicles (drive, turns, treads, ground, contact, the 12 chassis, damage and conditions, wrecks, roll-ins and returning seats), the bongs (all seven kinds, their reflexes, voice and knock-outs), the enemy AI's audible moments including C2, and the round's flow from RoundStarted through waves, the director, stragglers, the end beats, level unlocks and the training course. The surprise is how little of a vehicle's soundscape is an Event: the engine, treads, pull-away, brake, pivot, slides, water entry, wall slams, grinding and hull pressure are all state in drive_tank_with, press_treads and rapier's contact pairs, and fx.rs samples them. A replica steps no physics, so every contact sound is local-only online. The AI's barks are trace-only (trace_ai) and NOT_SENT, an enemy spotting a seat has no event even traced, and C2 is off with no producers to chatter from. The biggest holes are a contact/impact event (with impulse and what was struck), Ram and Wreck payloads (impact speed, killer, chassis), round beats that are only state edges (play starting, a wave cleared, the last enemy left), buffs that expire silently (the slime coat is not even on the wire), and a listener rule for 8 seats and big field maps. BB-102's event-built sheet had engine and tread loops but would miss the slams, grinds, brake, pivot, splash-in, damage tiers, buff loops, wreck burn, bong hops and landings, the bong's per-kind voice, and every AI bark.

domains.title: Effects, HUD, screens and online
domains.summary: Covered the effects bridge (fx.rs observe_events and sample_world, casings, pieces, fish, Spectacle/*_show, tick_presentation), feedback.rs, pose/particles, the online client (apply/predict/interp/events/client/round, lobby), every play screen and HUD readout, indicators/minimap/touch/bubble, the builder, the camera and the platform entries. The Event enum has 87 variants, not ~75: fx.rs handles 43 (2 partially) and ignores 44; the full mapping is in the extra `bridge` key. Biggest surprises: online, the own seat's `Fired` is still in the replica's `game.events` (only the press shows are dropped), so a Fired-hooked sound plays a round trip late or twice; the replica steps no physics, so every wall slam and scrape fx draws from contacts is silent and invisible online; `MissileLocked` is a 21st never-sent event missing from NOT_SENT; and the web page's audio-unlock hook resumes a `Module.audioContext` nothing sets, once. The HUD signals low ammo, out of ammo, low health, buffs expiring, the last enemy, a special becoming ready and air-support countdowns by colour only, and a crate respawning off-screen is signalled nowhere; no lobby/connection/seat moment is an Event, and Android keeps the audio device running while raylib blocks the loop on lost focus.

entities.name: Battle haze
states: 0..1, fed by hot remains, drained by the sky
entities.notes: Presentation only; could drive a distant battlefield bed.

entities.name: Hot remains
variants: Kind: Wreck, Bed (ember bed), Ruin (charred rubble), Stump, Tower, Crater
entities.notes: Gathered from state a replica keeps too (Game::smouldering). Quiet ember ticks and crackle; hiss of steam under rain.

entities.name: The enemies as a pack (shared alert, chained alerts, stragglers, C2)
states: alerted on a last-known seat position
entities.notes: The place a radio-chatter layer would live. None of it reaches a replica.

entities.name: Air support call
variants: counting vs waiting behind the seat's sortie
states: counting 15 s (HUD amber, red over the last three)
entities.notes: Seats only. A radio call is the natural cue.

entities.name: Apache-like helicopter
entities.notes: Escorts its seat 120 px off at up to 320 px/s and fires 2 seeker rockets every 1.6 s. 16 bullet hits down it, as does any other air strike. Needs a rotor-thump loop.

entities.name: A-10-like jet
entities.notes: Constant 264 px/s with banked turns; a cannon stripe then 2 bombs per pass. It is not an air target. Wants a jet roar with a strong Doppler flyby.

entities.name: Game::blast (the one blast)
variants: drum, lava bomb, drone, jet bomb (other domains' sources)
entities.notes: Hurts every hull and bong in reach whoever set it off (BB-188), shoves hulls with a skid, cracks tiles, breaks crates, sets grenades off. It emits no event of its own: each caller logs its own (Wreck, MissileBlast, GrenadeBlast, Blast, ...).

entities.name: Bong (either side's objective)
variants: BongKind Spike, Oggle, Gloop (players'); Blip, Puff, Capi, Fuzz (enemy) (bong.rs:59-104)
entities.notes: Cosmetic kind only; every kind shares the clips (BONG_SPEC.md:70-76). Bites only the other side (bong.rs:178-183), hops from any tank. BongState on the wire carries hp, flags DEAD/HOPPING/HURT/BITING/STUNNED/PULLED, the clip phase and the hop's landing (wire.rs:698-733). A character voice per kind is the natural sound design: a cactus, a one-eyed blob, a slime, a space-invader squid, a storm cloud, a mushroom kid, a soot puff.

entities.name: The enemy bong (Hunt)
variants: Blip (squid invader, tentacle slap, tractor beam home)
Puff (storm cloud, lightning bolt, rains out)
Capi (mushroom kid, spore puff, ducks into the soil)
Fuzz (soot puff, sneezes a soot ball, bursts into soot)
entities.notes: Bites seats; guards hold a leash round it. Its death wins a Hunt round (mod.rs:5619).

entities.name: The players' bong
variants: Spike (default, potted cactus, needle volley, hides in its pot)
Oggle (one-eyed feeler blob, feeler zap, deflates and zips off)
Gloop (bouncy slime, goo spit, splits into three)
entities.notes: Its death loses the round on the same frame (mod.rs:5610-5613). Heals only from a bong health pack, delivered or fetched (mod.rs:3675-3687, 3724-3751).

entities.name: The bong's voice and speech bubble
variants: line keys: beat say/nudge lines, bong-ow, bong-kit, bong-only-me, bong-healed, bong-chomp, bong-minigun, bong-down, bong-ready (bubble.rs:76-107)
BongKind of the map's players' bong
entities.notes: Owned by app.rs beside fx; training rounds only (bubble.rs:67-71); text only today. Words are revealed over time (bubble.rs:337), a natural hook for per-word babble.

entities.name: Map builder
variants: brush shapes PEN, RECT, FILL, SCATTER, SELECT, STAMPS
entities.notes: No toasts, one sticky status line, no hover states, a single yes/no dialog (REVERT).

entities.name: Camera (establishing shot)
variants: couch zoom into a split screen
entities.notes: Presentation only; plays inside the mission banner (establish.rs:1-26). The couch split screen (follow.rs:618-690) is also the listener question for two seats on one screen. The listener's candidate. Arena maps (<= 36x18 cells) are shown whole; field maps follow the seat. The view centre leads the seat and is kicked/shoved, so the listener should be the seat's hull, not the view centre. Enemies fire at a seat only from inside its sight box (+-11.5 x +-7.5 cells, framing.rs:32-40), which is always on screen - a natural audible radius for threats.

entities.name: Couch split screen
entities.notes: Two seats, one audio output: where one listener sits is a design decision.

entities.name: Level progress and unlocks
entities.notes: Local-only session state; the progress store hears of a change once (mode.rs:459).

entities.name: Supply crate
variants: weapon crates: Laser, Minigun, Plasma, Missiles, Flamethrower, Grenades, SonicHammer, Emp, GaussRail, FpvSwarm, RodFromGod, GravityWell
air support calls AirHeli/AirJet (the call is the air domain's)
entities.notes: Every pickup is a crate on a fixed map slot; respawns every pickup_respawn_seconds (15) while a slot is empty. Crack-open plus a per-kind payload sound.

entities.name: Rod crater
variants: filled to a ford under rain
entities.notes: Slows hulls; when filled, the ford's splash applies.

entities.name: The pacing director (field maps)
entities.notes: Intensity jumps with what a seat loses and is held up by live enemies in its sight box (codebase.md:920-931). Field maps with director_enabled only. The best existing driver for adaptive music.

entities.name: FPV drone
variants: locked on a tank, on the bong, or on nothing
states: Dive committed 64 px out, 0.2 s down
entities.notes: Quadcopter, 36 px up. Cruise buzz and dive scream, about 8 damage. An air target.

entities.name: Fuel drum
entities.notes: Grey hazard drum; harder, sharper blast (fuel_shock, bigger scorch); set off by another blast it launches 3-ish cells and blows where it lands.

entities.name: Lava bomb blast
entities.notes: Not a barrel: the kind a landing lava bomb goes off as (Drum::Lava, BlastParams::lava_bomb): a smaller wet splat that splashes burning lava, no screen flash, no cook-offs.

entities.name: Oil drum
variants: BlastShape: shot, ram, chained (smoulder), fire, plain
entities.notes: Red drum; its blast leaves a pool of fire (oil_pool_radius_cells 1, five cells). Deep whump with a fireball roar, cook-off pops after.

entities.name: Seat feedback (hurt, kill hold)
entities.notes: Reads hull damage and RoundStats::by_seat diffs after every step, so every cause shows - shot, blast, fire, lava, ooze. Works on a replica (app.rs:2774) except the kill hold. The cleanest 'you were hit' hook in the game.

entities.name: Burning ground cell
entities.notes: Hurts hulls over it, lights wood beside it, fuses drums in it, chars grass, burns ooze off, blocks the nav grid. The world's main crackle bed. On the wire as FireState.

entities.name: A tile alight
variants: plank wall (5 s, chunk by chunk)
tower (burns until repaired or dead, on Tower not Obstacle)
entities.notes: Flicker loop, embers, smoke and light; tile_flags::BURNING on the wire (towers excepted).

entities.name: Fish
variants: stream fish carried down the current
states: flopping on the bank (sonic, rod, well)
entities.notes: Cosmetic, owned by Fx, no RNG and nothing on the wire, but stepped on the round clock so a replica matches. None under ice. Hashed, never rolled; a replica throws the same fish. Hidden under ice.

entities.name: Ford (shallow water)
entities.notes: Slows and loosens a hull, wets its tracks, puts afterburn out, washes ooze off. Slosh and bow-wave loop by speed.

entities.name: Blast radius ring
states: burning red to white as it runs out
entities.notes: Game::blast_rings() is a ready-made danger warning: a rising tone toward the blast.

entities.name: Spent minigun case
variants: lying across or along the screen
entities.notes: Presentation only, owned by fx.rs (rand::rng, culled by the views, capped at fx_max_casings 400). A brass tinkle per bounce would be the real-life sound. Brass, tiny, many: one per round of a minigun burst. Cap fx_max_casings (casings.rs:81). Lands on whatever ground: no surface info.

entities.name: Crate opening animation
entities.notes: The symbol flies into its taker; a pickup sound should follow this, timed to open_seconds.

entities.name: Damaged-hull smoke
variants: black smoke + embers once the deck burns
entities.notes: No event: sampled from Tank damage every frame. The one particle class the cap protects - a player reads it.

entities.name: Flying debris
variants: wall pieces cut from a broken chunk's pixels
thrown drum parts and hull parts (Decal::thrown)
rubble rethrown by a later blast
entities.notes: Pieces are the fx layer's (local rand); thrown decals are hashed arcs derived from age. A clatter tail after blasts and collapses.

entities.name: Hit picture playing out
variants: ImpactKind: Shell, Bullet, Plasma(variant), Laser(red|blue), Deflect, Ricochet, Tesla, Ooze, Dust(material), Collapse(material), Ash
entities.notes: Started from events and from watch_impacts (projectile state by id), so the same picture plays on a replica and for a provisional own shot.

entities.name: Effects layer (Fx)
variants: ParticleKind: Spark, Chip, Dust, Smoke, Ember, Spray, Trail, Plume, Kick, Foam
Explosion: Charge, Oil, Fuel, Lava, Hull, Void, Thud
entities.notes: Owned by app.rs, not Game, so it may use rand::rng(). Keys its event half on game.frame() so a frozen or re-rendered frame emits nothing twice (fx.rs:316-321, 905-911). The template a sound layer copies: observe_events + sample_world, with a views cull (set_views). Particle cap fx_max_particles with a reserved floor for damaged-hull smoke (particles.rs:7-13); a sound layer needs the same kind of per-class voice floor so a flamethrower cannot starve the damage tell.

entities.name: Muzzle flash ripple
variants: shell, plasma, missile tube, grenade barrel, laser lens, minigun's first round, flame nozzle shimmer, gun tower burst
entities.notes: Game::muzzle_flashes (a Shockwave list) is the one per-launch cosmetic a sound could key on, but it carries no weapon kind and the flame nozzle pushes one every 11 frames. A Shockwave with only a centre; fx infers the heading from the nearest shot. Online the own seat's flash is put on at the press (present.rs:320 draw_muzzle).

entities.name: Hull slam and scrape
entities.notes: Read from Game::contacts() (rapier impulses). A replica steps no physics, so these never happen online except through Event::Ram.

entities.name: Wall piece / battle scar
entities.notes: Cut from the walls atlas; keeps no Material (pieces.rs:29-45). Cap fx_max_pieces.

entities.name: Gate (wave lane)
entities.notes: A lane at the field's edge a wave tank rolls in through from outside the field (RollIn, no body, no Ai). Off-screen engine approach.

entities.name: Tall grass, bushes and reeds
entities.notes: Soft cover, not an Obstacle. Sound: swish and rustle by hull speed, wetter for reeds, drier for desert straw; ambient hiss in the wind.

entities.name: Ground under the tracks
variants: Surface: Grass, Road, Sand, Ford, Deep, Ice
states: tread marks, berms, wet prints, mud splats, drips, silt, char
entities.notes: What a hull's runs are on (Tank::tread). The surface layer under the tank domain's track loop: dirt crunch, gravel road, sand hiss, mud squelch, snow crunch, ice scrape.

entities.name: Rubble on the ground
entities.notes: Slows a hull (rubble_light_speed, rubble_heavy_speed). Crunching masonry under the tracks; no tread surface for it today.

entities.name: HUD corner clusters
variants: CornerButton: Pause, Restart, Level, Build, Online, Leave, Players, Lamp
entities.notes: Readouts: health + hurt tick, weapon symbol + count + ring pips, gauss gauge, EMP offline flicker, air-support row, speed/shield/heat-shield gauges, lanterns, wave counter, enemies left, bong gauge, mission word, other seats' chips. Every edge is visual only.

entities.name: Off-screen arrows and awareness
variants: ArrowKind: enemy (merged), teammate, bong, gate, volcano, drone, rod zone, well, wind-up, aircraft
entities.notes: Its Note feed (indicators.rs:942-997) already computes the threat direction relative to the seat - the panning a sound layer needs.

entities.name: Play minimap
entities.notes: Blinks only; no pickups, no ping.

entities.name: Ice
entities.notes: Every water cell under snow. Keeps pace, loses grip/traction/brake: hulls slide ~100 px. Skittering scrape; no crack mechanic.

entities.name: Lamp post
entities.notes: One-shot tile lighting the ground at night; an EMP at night puts every post out for emp_lamp_seconds. Sound: sodium buzz with flicker, power-down clunk and power-up tick, glass smash.

entities.name: Lantern
entities.notes: A seat sets one down in a dark round (lamps_per_seat 3); any blast, a sonic wave or a rod breaks it. Sound: clink and wick catch, quiet flame flutter, glass smash.

entities.name: Lava
entities.notes: Burns hulls by heat (banks a tenth), afterburn after; lights the night. Thick bubbling loop, louder in a surge; sizzle on a hull.

entities.name: Air targets (air.rs)
variants: AirStrike: Bullet, Tesla, Emp, Sonic, Rail, Rod, Well
states: struck: hits counted (bullets) or downed at once
entities.notes: Game::strike_air is the one mutator, so a downed sound can key on DroneDowned and AircraftDowned with by.

entities.name: Charge-and-hold trigger (Tank::charge)
entities.notes: TankState::charge carries the exact ticks held, so progress can drive a pitch.

entities.name: Disabled state (EMP outage)
variants: enemy (brain off, coasting, turret sags) vs seat (special offline, lights out)
entities.notes: Lasts 3 s on a tank, 6 s on a tower, 10 s for the lamps at night.

entities.name: Knock and skid (combat::knock)
variants: sonic wave, rail recoil (and spin), rod shove ring, well fling
states: stopped by a wall or by friction
entities.notes: A hull sliding off its tracks for up to 1.2 s implies a scraping loop by speed and surface. Game::skidding() already feeds the fx dust.

entities.name: Enemy wind-up (Tank::tell / Windup)
variants: SonicHammer 0.55 s, Emp 0.5 s (the only weapons with tell_seconds)
states: lapsed (wreck, EMP, teleport, round end, weapon gone)
entities.notes: Its whole point is to be read before it lands, so it is the most important warning cue. Online it travels as TankState::tell in tenths.

entities.name: Zones (zone.rs)
entities.notes: ZoneState carries until in ticks, so countdown beeps can be derived on every screen.

entities.name: Mission (Protect, Hunt, Destroy)
entities.notes: Its banner opens every round with a banner (render/game.rs:504-516).

entities.name: Oil pool (map oil cell)
entities.notes: A hull driving through loads oil on its treads when oil_print_cells > 0 (default 0).

entities.name: Oil trail and prints
variants: printed by a hull (OilPrinted, fade eighths)
entities.notes: A fuse along the ground: fire runs along it a cell per 1/6 s. A travelling hiss.

entities.name: Online client (RoomClient, OnlineRound, replica)
variants: Phase: Connecting, Greeting, Lobby, Playing, Closed
entities.notes: The replica's game.events is overwritten each frame with what the interpolator hands over (apply.rs:783-789), once per snapshot when render time reaches it.

entities.name: Provisional own shot (predicted)
variants: ProvisionalKind: Shell, Bullet, Plasma; press shows: Beam, Sonic, Emp, Rail, ChargeEnd, Drone, Rod, Orb, Anchor
entities.notes: The own seat's shots exist in the picture before the room confirms them; the sound of firing and of the own impact should follow these, not the room's events.

entities.name: Room roster
variants: RosterSeat { seat, nick, chassis, ready, connected }
entities.notes: Only ever a whole Lobby::Roster; joins and leaves are diffs.

entities.name: Ooze puddle
entities.notes: Coats any hull over it (Slimed) which then corrodes at bio_slime_dps until it wears off or washes in water. Not on the wire.

entities.name: Ammo crate
entities.notes: Shells into the magazine.

entities.name: Bong health pack
entities.notes: Heals the collector side's bong (BongHealed is the bong domain's).

entities.name: Health pack
entities.notes: Heals pickup_heal_amount; its slot also rolls the shield, bong and tower bonus drops.

entities.name: Heat shield
entities.notes: heat_shield_seconds of no heat; puts a burning hull out.

entities.name: Spilled contents
variants: PickupKind that does not cook off
entities.notes: A broken crate's contents as a bare symbol.

entities.name: Rainbow shield
entities.notes: Full heal plus a shield pool on a clock.

entities.name: Speed-up
entities.notes: Refreshes speed_boost_duration_seconds.

entities.name: Tower pack
entities.notes: Mends and puts out every standing tower of the collector's side.

entities.name: Platform shell (web, iOS, Android, desktop)
entities.notes: No platform handles lifecycle events today; no audio device is initialised anywhere.

entities.name: Player input
variants: keyboard seat 1 (arrows + Space), seat 2 (WASD + Left Shift)
entities.notes: app.rs is the only raylib input reader; presses on HUD buttons and dialogs are hit-tested first (app.rs:2127-2260).

entities.name: Portal
entities.notes: Teleports a tank (and shots, weapons' domain) to another portal. Warbling hum loop each, whoosh at entry and exit.

entities.name: Minigun bullet
variants: tank minigun vs gun tower (Owner::Tower, never glances)
entities.notes: The only shot that strikes the air (drones, the helicopter). 1-2 damage a round.

entities.name: Ember
variants: from an ember bed in a gust (relight rule)
entities.notes: Thrown downwind from burning wood and trees every ember_interval_seconds (0.9). A tiny pop at launch; it can light what it lands on.

entities.name: EMP ring
variants: day vs night (at night every lamp post goes out)
states: front running out at 800 px/s to 160 px (a fifth of a second)
entities.notes: Nothing stops it (walls, water, tanks) and it hits both sides: tanks, towers, missiles, drones, the heli, orbs and wells. Bongs, being organic, are left alone.

entities.name: Flame stream
entities.notes: Game::flames() and the FLAME tank flag on the wire. Continuous roar, a splash on whatever caps it.

entities.name: Bio slush glob
entities.notes: Lobbed ooze; wobbling wet whoosh, a big acid splat. Not on the wire.

entities.name: Grenade
variants: on dry ground, ice (drag x0.25), water (drag x4)
entities.notes: Steel canister, 6 s fuse, the band blinking from 1.5 to 10 Hz. Clinks and rolls on every surface - none of it evented.

entities.name: Helicopter rocket (seeker missile)
states: the missile's own climb, lock, dive and blast
entities.notes: A plain proj.missile spawned with no Event::Fired. The missiles domain owns its flight and blast.

entities.name: Jet bomb
variants: either of the two held when a friend is in reach
states: released and landing on the same tick, astride the target
entities.notes: Radius 64, 75-85 damage, screen flash. No fall time, so no whistle moment exists.

entities.name: Jet cannon burst
variants: held when a friend is in reach (logged nowhere)
states: lands 160 px ahead of the jet on the same tick it fires
entities.notes: Up to 6 per run in a 192 px stripe; radius 28, 9 damage. There is no flight time.

entities.name: Laser beam
variants: legs bent by portals (leg 0 from the lens)
entities.notes: Instant: start and end in Event::LaserBeam. A zap with a burn at the end.

entities.name: Lava bomb
variants: aimed at a seat (volcano_bomb_aimed_share) or round the crater
states: flying (1.9 s arc, warning ring on the ground)
entities.notes: Nine an eruption. A falling whistle/roar that grows as LavaBomb::left shrinks; a wet heavy splat and sizzle.

entities.name: Seeker missile
variants: live vs Dead (EMP-killed, lands a dud)
entities.notes: No hit test; flies over everything, only its blast touches. A rocket motor loop whose pitch follows speed and height; game.missiles() lists exhaust positions.

entities.name: Gravity well orb
variants: anchor by Press, Contact or Range
entities.notes: Slow violet orb. A droning hum suits it. Travels on the wire as ShotKind::Orb.

entities.name: Plasma bolt
states: Flying (527 px/s, a breathing shader orb)
entities.notes: Never ricochets off tiles, but a shield turns it back. An energy hum in flight.

entities.name: Gauss slug (instant trace)
variants: Pierced: Tank, Shield, Bong, Tile(Material), Drone
entities.notes: It crosses the whole field in one tick and goes through everything in its lane, so a sound would stagger the pierce hits by their distance along the line.

entities.name: Tungsten rod (the impact)
entities.notes: Crushes everything in 64 px, breaks tiles out to 104 px, shoves out to 208 px. The biggest single sound event in the game.

entities.name: Tank shell
variants: shooter_row (chassis) and variant (sheet row) carried on the shell; online only variant travels (ShotState.variant)
states: Flying (522 px/s, until it meets something)
entities.notes: Flies to the field's edge if nothing stops it (about 2 s across the default field). A whistle or crack-by per flying shell, keyed by its id.

entities.name: Sonic wave (cone of sound)
variants: falloff 1 at the pivot to 0.35 at the 208 px rim
shadowed by walls (Material::blocks_sound) cast per ray
over water: chop; over lava: smoke
states: front travelling at 640 px/s (about a third of a second to full reach)
entities.notes: Every wall stops it, so wall occlusion fits it best. It strikes each thing once as the front passes, so its impacts arrive spread over about 0.33 s, nearest first. Damages both sides.

entities.name: Spall fragments
states: instant cone off a breached wall's far face (96 px reach)
entities.notes: Only a shot of 10 damage or more that breaks chunks throws it; it hurts whoever is behind the wall, either side.

entities.name: Tesla bolt
entities.notes: Instant; sharp crack of an arc with a buzzing tail.

entities.name: Drum in the air
entities.notes: A fuel drum another blast launched (or any drum a sonic wave threw). Tumbling whoosh, a clang-boom on landing.

entities.name: Gravity well (zone)
states: Pulling 4 s (last second: the core beats at 6 Hz)
entities.notes: Pulls hulls, shots, missiles, drones, grenades, drums, crates, the bong and the fish, then implodes and flings. A long modulated drone that tops out at the collapse.

entities.name: The round's life
states: decided: hitstop, slow-mo, finale, verdict, countdown
entities.notes: EndBeats (mod.rs:398-421): finale round_finale_seconds 2.4 s, verdict fade, countdown. The session's time_scale holds and slows the local round's end (mode.rs:744-764). Session::time_scale (mode.rs:748-764) and Feedback::time_scale scale the round's clock; a mixer must choose which sounds follow the scaled clock.

entities.name: Rainbow shield
entities.notes: A hum loop while up (TankState SHIELD flag and shield charge on the wire); the deflect and the break are evented. Raised by a pickup (pickup domain).

entities.name: Tank (any hull)
variants: TankKind, 12 chassis in 7 mass classes (lib.rs:190-213, tuning.rs:3473): narrow scout/wraith 0.77, compact flak/glacier 0.8, std assault/warden 1.0, long longbow/obelisk 1.2, wide breaker/ravager 1.26, super_heavy titan 1.89, super_long leviathan 1.86
twin-barrel chassis assault, flak, ravager, obelisk, titan (tuning.rs:3490)
tread profile per row; the titan has four runs (lib.rs:381-394)
team: enemy block or seats P1..P8 (tank.rs:2430)
entities.notes: Movement is 4-direction with momentum: Tank::control snaps rotation and sets the commanded cardinal velocity (tank.rs:2335), drive_tank_with applies one impulse a step toward it (mod.rs:6681-6809): accel capped by tank_accel_force times mass_factor^0.5, decel an exponential (tank_decel_curve_rate), grip across the runs. Top speed 210 px/s for seats, 160 for enemies times a spawn variance (tuning.rs:530-538); damage limps it to 0.35 (tank.rs:1511). The turret has no independent aim: it eases after the hull at 1800 deg/s, the hull sprite at 720 deg/s (tank.rs:2383-2411). Body velocity, facing, hp, flags (wreck, shield, boost, burning, hit, flame, heat shield), skid, disabled and tell travel in TankState (wire.rs:486-561); commanded intent, throttle, spin and slime do not. Footing (mod.rs:6346-6443) is the ground's say: ford pace 0.55 and grip 0.5, ice grip 0.15/traction 0.4/brake 0.1, rain grip 0.5, lava, crater pits, rubble, current and gusts. Loops implied: engine, treads, slide/skid, wading, fire/ooze/shield/boost layers.

entities.name: An enemy tank
entities.notes: Ai is server-only: a replica's enemies carry no Ai (waves.rs:177-180), so any bark keyed on AI state needs an event that travels. The behaviour tree's actions are named (ai.rs:4127-4363). Far field-map tanks coast on their last intent (field.rs:105-109): their engines still run.

entities.name: A player's tank
variants: couch (two seats, arrows+Space, WASD+Left Shift) or online room seat
chassis from --tank/--tank2, the map or a roll
states: returning through a gate with the next wave
dropped in near the living seats
training respawn in the last door opened
client-owned online (pose accepted, Placed when refused)
entities.notes: The listener's own tank: its engine and treads deserve the closest mix. Online the client owns and predicts its own hull, so its locomotion sounds must come from the predicted pose, not the snapshot (docs/online-coop-prd.md 4.14). A wrecked seat in a wave round of two or more comes back with the next wave (waves.rs:475-488, 505-515). Seat-on-seat rams exist only for exactly two seats (mod.rs:5030).

entities.name: A hull's tracks on the ground
variants: wet tracks for wear_wet_carry_px after a ford
entities.notes: Tank::tread (tank.rs:671-693) is pressed every step by press_treads (simulation/wear.rs:201-260) and read by Game::driving (simulation/wear.rs:86-109): surface, roll, speed, velocity, speeding_up, wet, odometer. A replica presses its own treads in ease_hulls (mod.rs:2714-2726), so this state exists online too. Grouser period 4 px (lib.rs:381-394): a clatter rate per px rolled. No rubble surface.

entities.name: Range target board
entities.notes: Plywood bullseye; never rolled flammable but always catches from fire. Hollow thock on a hit, splinter on its last point, a 3 s crackle and a creak as the stand gives way.

entities.name: Any tile
entities.notes: A tile of any material, where the interaction does not depend on which.

entities.name: Arena boundary wall
entities.notes: The field's edge walls; a shot ends on it as HitTarget::Wall. Dull impact, no material.

entities.name: Brick wall
entities.notes: Breaks chunk by chunk (16 chunks, ChunksBroken per blow), collapses at wall_collapse_chunks, dominoes weak neighbours, spalls fragments onto a tank behind a breach. Sound: dry masonry crack per chunk, a crumbling roar on collapse, grit on armour for spall.

entities.name: Concrete wall
entities.notes: Twice brick's work; gives way into a rebar cage that stops hulls but lets shots through until cage_cut_hits heavy blasts. Sound: heavier, duller masonry; a metallic groan and twang when the rebar is left and when it is cut.

entities.name: Training door
entities.notes: Only on training maps; opens when its beat is done. A heavy gate sound. Banded iron with a hazard band (training.rs draw_door). Opens with no ObstacleDestroyed (training.rs:577-591).

entities.name: Fence
entities.notes: Amount-blind two-state: a pristine fence dies outright at fence_one_shot_chance else drops to damaged. Sound: light wood snap and rattle.

entities.name: Glass pane
entities.notes: Cracks then shatters; a shattering pane shatters a cracked neighbour after glass_cascade_seconds and cracks an intact one. The one material a sonic wave breaks. Sound: bright ticks and cracks, a big shatter, a tinkling cascade along a run.

entities.name: Iron wall
entities.notes: Permanent; shells ricochet off it (weapons' Ricochet). Every hit is a clang with sparks. No death sound.

entities.name: Sandbag
entities.notes: Knee-high: shots pass over at sandbag_pass_over_chance; a ram flattens it after sandbag_ram_seconds; the flame collapses it. Sound: soft thump, sand pour.

entities.name: Tree
states: leaning under a ram (ram_timer, lean nibble on the wire)
entities.notes: 48 px art on a 32 px cell; a hull pushes it over (ram_seconds by species), a shot or blast breaks or lights it. Sound: leaves rustle, trunk creak under a push, crack-swish-thud fall, a crown fire roars.

entities.name: Plank wall
variants: flammable or breaking (rolled per tile at spawn, wood_flammable_chance)
entities.notes: Either splinters or catches fire when it reaches zero; a burning plank chars chunk by chunk and throws embers downwind. Sound: hollow timber thunk, splinter crack, burning crackle loop.

entities.name: Bio slush mortar
entities.notes: Lobs ooze globs between bio_min_range and bio_range. Wet mortar thoonk, gurgling idle.

entities.name: Gun tower
entities.notes: Turns, leads, fires minigun bullets in bursts, anti-air first; its ammunition cooks off when it dies. Servo whir and a tinny burst.

entities.name: Tesla coil
entities.notes: Charges while an opposing hull is in reach, strikes at full charge, chains tesla_chain_jumps, arcs at drones on its own clock, discharges into everything close when it dies. Rising whine is the tell.

entities.name: The training course's run
variants: beat 1..N with its triggers (flags, collect, destroyed, past_col, bong_full, wrecks)
entities.notes: Never lost, never hosted: BeatDone, DoorOpened, FlagTaken, BongRevived are NOT_SENT and need not be.

entities.name: Training flag
entities.notes: Not solid; the first seat to reach it takes it (training.rs:221-238).

entities.name: Mid-screen banners
entities.notes: hud.rs:1751-1753 decides which owns the middle row.

entities.name: The bong's speech bubble
variants: by BongKind (the line names the bong)
entities.notes: Training rounds only; training maps are never hosted, so local only.

entities.name: Players dialog and kept-map question
variants: yes/no about a kept map (REVERT, changed original)
entities.notes: The only confirmation dialog in the game.

entities.name: End screen and verdict
entities.notes: Stats: TIME, DESTROYED n/total, per-seat kills, friendly-fire line; buttons LEVELS, PLAY AGAIN, NEXT LEVEL / BACK TO LEVEL 1.

entities.name: Level select
entities.notes: Freezes the round behind it (Session::playing).

entities.name: Online lobby
variants: Stage: Waiting, Room, Closed, code entry
entities.notes: Buttons Host, Join, Back, Map/Mission prev/next, Key(i), Del, Confirm, Ready, Start/REMATCH, Leave, Kick(row). QR is display only; no nickname field, no chat.

entities.name: Mode swap (plates changing places)
entities.notes: Cut under reduced motion. The natural place to switch the ambience/music bed between play and builder.

entities.name: Touch scheme (stick and fire)
entities.notes: No haptics anywhere in the codebase.

entities.name: Volcano
variants: set off early by a rod (Volcano::set_off_shift)
entities.notes: Cycle is a pure function of the clock (plus a shift on the wire). Sub-bass rumble, a huge eruption boom with a roaring fountain, hissing cool-down; off-screen arrow exists, so it should be heard off-screen too.

entities.name: Deep water (lake)
entities.notes: A collider to hulls, nothing to shots; no fire, no scorch; blasts on it throw spray. Lapping/babbling ambience.

entities.name: The wave scheduler
entities.notes: WaveStatus (waves.rs:127-152) and wave_banner (waves.rs:158-163) are readable; next_wave travels in RoundState.

entities.name: EMP burst (toroid coil projector)
variants: seat vs enemy (0.5 s crackle tell)
states: offline for 3 s after its own pulse (Tank::special_offline)
entities.notes: 3 pulses per crate. Its reload is its own offline: the HUD flickers WPN OFFLINE until it is back.

entities.name: Flamethrower
variants: player-only (the fuel pickup is the players')
states: streaming (flame_held, fuel draining dt a frame)
entities.notes: Trigger::Stream, no cooldown; one Fired per hold. A continuous roar whose length follows the jet's reach (capped at the first tile).

entities.name: FPV swarm halo and relay module
variants: team colour lamps per seat, red for enemies
states: hovering in the halo (drawn only, no entity)
entities.notes: The halo is just the count, drawn. It still implies a constant low rotor hum round the tank, scaled by how many drones are left.

entities.name: Gauss rail (coil gun on the left cheek)
states: charging 0..1.5 s (the hull crawls at 0.2 pace)
vent warning in the last 0.6 s before 3.5 s
entities.notes: The best candidate for a charge hum: progress 0..1 is exact on the wire (TankState::charge ticks). An enemy's charge is its tell, and the counter is to read it.

entities.name: Gravity well projector
entities.notes: Two presses: launch, then anchor.

entities.name: Grenade launcher
entities.notes: Trigger::Press; a hollow thunk and a small kick back (sent as Shoved for an owned seat).

entities.name: Laser module
variants: LaserVariant Red (base) / Blue (x1.2 damage, rolled at pickup)
entities.notes: Instant hit, no travel: the beam is one LaserBeam event per leg plus its Hit. Full-auto while held, about 6.7 beams a second.

entities.name: M134 minigun
variants: per TankKind damage factor only; one bullet art for all
states: firing (9-round burst, a round every 2 ticks = 30/s, bursts chain while held)
entities.notes: Tank::minigun_spin (0..1) is simulation state and drives the module's turning cells: the natural driver for a motor whine loop whose pitch follows spin. The round report is a 30 Hz stream, better a modulated loop than 30 one-shots. 240 rounds a crate, 8 s of fire.

entities.name: Seeker missile pod
states: reloading (1.3 s, tubes refill one by one, missile_tubes_empty)
entities.notes: One Fired per volley of four. Trigger::Auto: a held key fires the next volley as soon as the reload is out.

entities.name: Plasma cannon
variants: twin barrel chassis fire two bolts 0.05 s apart
entities.notes: Fired like the shell (Trigger::Press), heavier knockback, never ricochets; a heavier, electric report.

entities.name: Rod from god uplink and reticle
variants: seat reticle in team colour, enemy in red
states: reticle up (charge with Stick::Aim; the hull stands still)
reticle stepping a cell at a time
entities.notes: Press, steer, release. The enemy's dotted designator line shows which seat it is painting.

entities.name: Main cannon (shell)
variants: per TankKind calibre: tank_damage_factor scout 0.75, assault 1.0, breaker 1.20, longbow 1.35, flak 0.90, wraith 0.75, warden 1.0, ravager 1.20, glacier 0.90, obelisk 1.35, titan 1.55, leviathan 1.60 (src/tuning.rs:3481)
twin barrel: assault, flak, ravager, obelisk, titan (tank_barrel_lateral_offset > 0, src/tuning.rs:3490), the second shell 0.05 s after the first
shell sheet row by chassis (src/lib.rs:314): 2 blue, 0 orange, 1 red standard; 7 titan and 8 leviathan super-heavy
hull mass factor 0.77 to 1.89 (src/tuning.rs:3473): how much the hull rocks on recoil
states: magazine refilling (1 shell / 2 s up to 20)
entities.notes: Trigger::Press, one Fired per press. Every shot shoves the hull back (Knock::recoil) and kicks the turret recoil cells (Tank::kick). Shell speed is the same for every chassis (522 px/s); only damage, mass and the barrel count differ, so pitch/weight should key off tank_damage_factor and mass, and twin chassis need a doubled report.

entities.name: Sonic hammer (LRAD dish on the roof)
variants: seat (fires on the press) vs enemy (0.55 s tell first)
entities.notes: One press = one blast; 7 per crate, 14 max. No muzzle flash; the dish flashes white. Small kick back on the shooter.

entities.name: The sky
entities.notes: Picked by a hash of the seed; a room's round is its map's sky. Drives the ambience bed and the mix (fog muffling).

entities.name: Rain
entities.notes: Wet grip, mud, filled ruts, craters fill, steam off smoulders. Rain loop with layers on water, on hulls, on fire.

entities.name: Sandstorm gusts
variants: gust direction east swung by sand_gust_spread_deg
states: a gust front crossing the field
entities.notes: A front sweeps the field at sand_gust_front_speed; behind it the wind carries hulls downwind and scours marks. Pure function of the clock.

entities.name: Snow
entities.notes: Freezes all water, soft ground everywhere, powder off the tracks. A hushed bed.

entities.name: Thunderstorm lightning
states: a strike in most lightning_gap_seconds (7) windows, double flicker
entities.notes: Pure function of the round clock, no position. Thunder wanted.

entities.name: The grass wind
entities.notes: On every map under every sky: gust fronts roll across the field along grass_gust_heading_deg (wind_at, mean_wind). Cosmetic, pure in clock and position: the wind loop's driver.

entities.name: A wood
states: trails reworked when a tree falls
entities.notes: Trees as a whole: crowns, trails, forest floor, undergrowth. No ambience of its own today.

entities.name: Tank wreck
variants: wreck_col roll; the first variant throws its turret clear (tank.rs:1581)
mushroom cloud in 70% of kills, hashed (blast.rs:179, tuning.rs:3336)
chassis mass (damping x mass factor, mod.rs:2665)
entities.notes: See-through to gunfire (hits.rs). A fire crackle loop while it burns, from game.burning_wrecks(). Keeps its full-mass dynamic body with heavy damping (physics.rs:323-340), so it can still be shoved. Game::contacts lists a burning wreck but not a dead one (mod.rs:6041).

entities.name: Rod call (circle, red beam, countdown)
variants: provisional (a client's own) vs the room's
states: beam flickering for the first 2 s
last second: wider beam, circle beating at 4 Hz, count turning white
entities.notes: Lands 3 s after the call, always. Everyone sees it. It implies an orbital uplink hum and a 3-2-1 count.

interactions.description: A trigger press fires a shell from the main gun: muzzle blast, the hull rocks back, the turret kicks.
interactions.visual: muzzle flash ripple (src/simulation/weapons.rs:179), sparks and smoke down the line (src/fx.rs:1287), turret recoil cells (src/tank.rs:1612), Fire0-2 frames (src/render/shell.rs)

sound.description: punchy cannon thump with a metallic breech clank, weight by calibre
sound.notes: Look the tank up by Fired.slot: tank_damage_factor for pitch/weight (6 classes: 0.75, 0.90, 1.0, 1.20, 1.35, 1.55-1.60), mass factor for body. Pan and attenuate by the tank's position (Fired has none). Cap enemy copies; the local seat's own shot loudest.

interactions.description: A twin-barrel chassis fires its second shell 0.05 s after the first, from the other barrel.

trigger.name: Tank::pending_shot timer runs out (a new Shell id appears); Tank::recoil_pose goes to 2

interactions.visual: its own muzzle flash locally (src/simulation/weapons.rs:179); on a replica only the turret's second kick (src/tank.rs:1678), no second ripple (src/net/apply.rs:676)

sound.description: a second, slightly lower crack a beat after the first
sound.notes: Either schedule it from Fired + Tank::twin_gun() + tank_twin_shot_delay_seconds, or fire it on the new shell id. Rows 1, 4, 7, 9, 10.

interactions.description: A press with fewer shells than the shot needs (two on a twin chassis) does nothing at all.
interactions.visual: none (the HUD's count reads 0)

sound.description: a dull empty click of the breech
sound.notes: Local seat only. Same hole for plasma, minigun, missiles, grenades (each `if ammo > 0` arm).

interactions.description: The magazine regains one shell every 2 s up to 20; nothing marks a shell coming back or the magazine filling.
interactions.visual: the HUD count and the ammo pips under a seat's ring (src/tank.rs:3216)

sound.description: a soft mechanical rack; a firmer clunk when the magazine is full again
sound.notes: Local seat only, quiet. TankState.shells online.

interactions.description: The laser fires an instant beam from its lens to the first thing on the gun line, every 0.15 s while held.
interactions.visual: lens flash (src/simulation/mod.rs:4876), the beam (src/render/laser.rs), lens cell (src/tank.rs:1621)

sound.description: a sharp electric zap with a sizzle tail
sound.notes: Blue a fuller, lower zap. LaserBeam gives start and end, so a stereo sweep along the beam is possible. Own seat: PressShow::Beam (src/net/predict.rs:950).

interactions.description: Where the beam stops it burns: a tank, a bong, a tile or the field's edge.

trigger.name: Event::LaserBeam { portal: false } end point + Event::Hit { cause: Laser }

interactions.visual: burn sparks in the beam's colour (src/fx.rs:1261), impact flash (src/simulation/mod.rs:4914)

sound.description: a hot hiss and crackle where the beam lands
sound.notes: A beam on a shield still reports a Hit with damage 0 and no deflect.

interactions.description: A press fires a plasma bolt; a twin chassis fires a second bolt 0.05 s later from the other barrel.

trigger.name: Event::Fired { weapon: "plasma" } (second bolt: Tank::pending_plasma_shot, no event)

interactions.visual: muzzle flash (src/simulation/weapons.rs:188), coils lit through the recoil (src/tank.rs:1612), Fire frames (src/render/plasma.rs)

sound.description: a charged thoom with a rising electric whine
sound.notes: Purple a deeper, buzzier variant.

interactions.description: A pull on barrels at rest logs Fired at once, and the barrels take 0.1 s to come up to speed before the first round.

trigger.name: Event::Fired { weapon: "minigun" }, then Tank::minigun_spin rising from 0 toward 1

interactions.visual: the module's turning cells, faster with spin (src/tank.rs:2005)

sound.description: an electric motor whine rising in pitch with the barrels
sound.notes: Pitch and gain = minigun_spin. A replica rebuilds the spin from each room Fired (Tank::kick_minigun, src/tank.rs:2020), so the loop works there too, a little coarser.

interactions.description: Once at speed the gun fires a round every 2 ticks (30 a second) in bursts of 9 that chain while held: one unbroken stream.

trigger.name: Tank::minigun_burst fires a round (a new Bullet id in the world); no event per round

interactions.visual: one muzzle flash per burst only (src/simulation/weapons.rs:306), the bullet's Muzzle frame, a casing per round (src/fx.rs:1345)

sound.description: the M134 brrrt: a 30 Hz ripping stream
sound.notes: Better a loop gated by rounds actually leaving (count new bullet ids per frame, as watch_casings does) than 30 one-shots. Own seat online: Predictor::launch_due per round (src/net/predict.rs:1085).

interactions.description: After the last round, or when it runs dry mid-burst, the barrels run down over 0.6 s.

trigger.name: Tank::minigun_spin falling while minigun_burst is None

interactions.visual: the turning cells slowing (src/tank.rs:2013)

sound.description: the motor whine winding down, a dry rattle at the end
sound.notes: Same loop as the spin-up, pitch falling.

interactions.description: The last round leaves mid-burst: the burst stops short, the barrels spin on empty and the trigger falls back to shells.
interactions.visual: none (the module and the HUD slot disappear)

sound.description: the motor spinning free with a hollow click
sound.notes: TankState.weapon/ammo online.

interactions.description: Every round throws a brass case out of the port, sideways and a little back, on a tumbling arc.

trigger.name: Fx::watch_casings sees a new tank Bullet at its muzzle

interactions.visual: the case (src/casings.rs:146)

sound.description: a light metallic flick
sound.notes: Fold into minigun_fire; separate only for the local seat.

interactions.description: A case lands, bounces once or twice and lies still.

trigger.name: Casing z reaches 0 with vz < -60 (bounce) in Casings::tick

interactions.visual: the case on the ground (src/casings.rs:162)

sound.description: brass tinkling on the ground, a shower of it in a long stream
sound.notes: Cap hard (a few voices), quieter on grass, silent in water. Needs a hook: Casings::tick returns nothing.

interactions.description: A pull starts a volley of four, the first tube now and the rest a beat apart.
interactions.visual: the first tube's puff (src/simulation/weapons.rs:229)

sound.description: a pod clack as the volley starts
sound.notes: The per-tube launch is the real sound; Fired is only its start. Own seat online: not predicted, the room's Fired arrives late.

interactions.description: Each of the four tubes launches its missile 0.05 s after the last, fanned out, each with a small kick.

trigger.name: fire_missile from tick_queued_shots (a new Missile id); no event per tube

interactions.visual: a puff at the tube's mouth (src/simulation/weapons.rs:229; replica: src/net/apply.rs:1104), smoke trail (src/fx.rs:1621)

sound.description: a rocket fwoosh, four in a rapid ripple
sound.notes: Pan each by its tube's fan. MissileState arrives per id on the wire.

interactions.description: Each missile climbs, hangs at its apex, accelerates after its target and dives.

trigger.name: Game::missiles() (key, exhaust, lift) while not dead

interactions.visual: the sprite lifted over its shadow (src/render/missile.rs), smoke trail and motor sparks (src/fx.rs:1621)

sound.description: a rocket roar whose pitch follows speed
sound.notes: One voice per volley is enough; doppler past the listener.

interactions.description: At the top of its climb a missile locks onto the nearest opposing tank in range, or onto the launcher's aim point.
interactions.visual: none

sound.description: a short seeker chirp
sound.notes: One per missile, four per volley: play once per volley.

interactions.description: An enemy's missile has locked onto a seat: that seat should hear it coming.

trigger.name: Event::MissileLocked { target: Some(seat slot) } from an enemy's missile

interactions.visual: none

sound.description: an urgent radar-warning beep for the targeted seat
sound.notes: Only for the local seat targeted. Impossible online today.

interactions.description: Inside the commit distance the missile stops tracking and dives on the spot.
interactions.visual: the sprite tipping down (src/missile.rs:241), the seat's blast ring (src/simulation/grenades.rs:169)

sound.description: a falling whistle in the last moment
sound.notes: Online only the height falling can stand in (MissileState has no stage).

interactions.description: A missile reaches the ground and bursts in a small blast that hurts everyone in reach, its shooter's side included.
interactions.visual: a small leaning fireball, ripple, scorch (src/simulation/missiles.rs:153), sparks and smoke (src/fx.rs:1094)

sound.description: a sharp, compact explosion, four in a rolling ripple
sound.notes: Four within ~0.2 s: vary pitch per copy, cap at 3 voices.

interactions.description: A missile an EMP killed falls and hits the ground with no blast.
interactions.visual: dust and pale sparks (src/fx.rs:1133)

sound.description: a dead metal thud and a fizzle
sound.notes: Splash in water.

sound.notes: Duck the mix briefly; a water spout variant.

interactions.description: A hull with a heat shield takes no burn and no afterburn; the contact is still reported.

trigger.name: Event::Hit { cause: Flame, damage: 0 } with Tank::takes_heat() false

interactions.visual: the heat-shield ring (src/tank.rs:3029)

sound.description: a cool deflecting hiss instead of the sizzle
sound.notes: HEAT_SHIELD flag on the wire.

interactions.description: A hull the stream touched keeps burning for 2.75 s off the stream; water or a heat shield puts it out.

trigger.name: Tank::burn_timer > 0 (Game::burning_tanks); first tick a Hit { cause: Fire }

interactions.visual: embers and smoke off the hull (src/fx.rs:1665)

sound.description: a crackling fire on the hull
sound.notes: BURNING flag on the wire. A hiss when wading puts it out.

interactions.description: A bong in the stream burns at its own rate.

trigger.name: Event::Hit { target: Bong, cause: Flame, damage: 0 } on first contact

interactions.description: A shell in flight crosses the field at 522 px/s until it meets something.

interactions.description: A plasma orb crackles with energy in flight.

sound.description: a buzzing electric hum with doppler
sound.notes: Nearest few bolts only.

interactions.visual: none

sound.notes: Detectable client-side for every listener seat (ShotState positions online); once per shot id. A laser's near pass can be judged from the LaserBeam segment.

interactions.description: A shell, bullet or bolt rolls a pass-over on a sandbag, fence, drum, lamp post or sapling and flies on.
interactions.visual: none

sound.description: a soft whip of air or a grazing tick

interactions.visual: impact flash (src/simulation/mod.rs:5270), sparks, armour flecks, smoke and the hull's flash (src/fx.rs:1186), impact frames (src/fx.rs:1310)

sound.description: a heavy metallic clang for shells, an electric crack for plasma, a ping for bullets, a sizzle for the laser
sound.notes: Look the target's chassis up by slot (TankState.row online) for armour weight. damage is what the hull took: 0 means the shield took it. When killed, let the Wreck cue lead. Bullets: cap per target (30/s).

interactions.description: The seat that fired should hear its own shot land, on any target, from across the field.

trigger.name: none in the event: Tank::hit_by_seat (cleared each frame, not on the wire)

interactions.description: A seat's shot, beam, stream, spall or blast hurts another seat at full strength (friendly_fire_damage_factor 1.0, BB-188).

interactions.visual: the hull's flash and the hurt feedback (src/fx.rs:1186, src/feedback.rs:192)

sound.description: a dull warning buzz for the shooter on top of the hull hit
sound.notes: Cannot tell a teammate's shell from an enemy's today.

sound.description: brick crunch, iron clang, wood thock, glass crack, sand thud, drum boom-tick, foliage rustle
sound.notes: Material is the richest payload in the domain. A burning tile or a fused drum still reports the rolled damage. The death that may follow is the tile domain's cue.

interactions.description: A shot that meets nothing flies on to the field's boundary wall and bursts there.

sound.notes: Targets: drone.fpv, aircraft.heli.

interactions.visual: ricochet impact and sparks (src/fx.rs:1150)

sound.description: a hollow drum bong or a tower's steel ping, then a whine
sound.notes: Targets drum.oil, drum.fuel, tower.tesla, tower.gun, tower.bio.

interactions.visual: ricochet sparks (src/fx.rs:1150)

sound.notes: About 1.5 a second per minigun on target: cap 2 voices. Its later Hit is 0 damage.

interactions.visual: deflect impact and cold sparks (src/fx.rs:1143)

sound.description: a bright glassy ting with a shimmering tail
sound.notes: A minigun stream on a shield is 30 a second: cap and pitch-walk.

interactions.description: A beam, blast, ram, stream, fire or bite on a shielded hull is soaked by the pool; the hull takes nothing.

trigger.name: Tank::take_damage spends shield_hp and returns 0 (Hit reports damage 0)

interactions.visual: the shield ring drains (src/tank.rs:3011)

sound.description: a dull energy thrum
sound.notes: Online: TankState.shield dropping between snapshots.

interactions.description: While a shield is up the hull carries a rainbow ring.
interactions.visual: the rainbow ring (src/tank.rs:3011)

sound.description: a soft shimmering hum, wavering as it drains
sound.notes: Local seat audible; others faint. Modulate by shield_charge.

sound.description: a glassy shatter with a sinking whoosh; a fizzle when it simply times out
sound.notes: Not drained on the end screen.

interactions.visual: an impact flash at the midpoint (src/simulation/mod.rs:5140), both shells' impact frames

sound.description: a sharp double clang-boom in the air
sound.notes: A rare, satisfying moment: worth a distinct cue. Not run on the end screen.

interactions.visual: the hull's flash and a spray of masonry toward it (src/fx.rs:964)

sound.description: a gritty spray of stone rattling on armour
sound.notes: The fragments with nobody behind are silent and undrawn (only ChunksBroken).

interactions.description: A shell, bullet, bolt or laser leg passing a portal's anchor goes in and comes out of another on the same heading.

trigger.name: Event::ShotTeleported { id, x, y, to_x, to_y } (id None for a beam)

interactions.visual: a blue spit of sparks at both ends (src/fx.rs:1057)

sound.description: a short warping zip at the entry and a pop at the exit

interactions.visual: the impact frames and fx.watch_impacts bursts (src/fx.rs:1310)

sound.description: silent by design; a real hulk would clang
sound.notes: Leave silent to match the rule, or add a faint hollow tick.

interactions.description: Every hull in a blast's reach, either side, takes falling-off damage and is thrown with a skid, unless a permanent tile covers it.

sound.description: a soft thump (the yelp and the hop are the bong domain's)

interactions.description: A blast's shove takes the hull off its tracks for a short skid, scraping until it stops.
interactions.visual: dust scraped up as it slides (src/fx.rs:1452)

sound.description: a grinding scrape of steel on ground
sound.notes: Shared with the sonic hammer's and the well's knocks.

interactions.description: A tank's damage reaches the max: it explodes, chips everything around it (its own side too) and becomes a burning wreck.

trigger.name: Event::Wreck { slot, x, y } then Game::blast(tank_wreck)

interactions.visual: shockwave, fireball (sometimes a mushroom), impact and screen flash, scorch, parts thrown (src/simulation/mod.rs:5385), sparks and smoke (src/fx.rs:988)

sound.description: a big rolling explosion with metal debris raining
sound.notes: Size by the wreck's chassis (look up by slot). A seat's wreck wants a darker stinger. Multi-kills: one flash gap rule, voice cap 3.

sound.description: a short rewarding sting for the killer

interactions.description: Two delayed pops of ammo cooking off over 1.6 s after a kill, cosmetic only.

sound.description: a crackling fire with metal ticking as it cools
sound.notes: Nearest 2-3 wrecks only. A replica counts its own wreck age.

sound.description: a heavy steel-on-steel crunch

interactions.visual: slam (src/fx.rs:1018)

sound.description: a lighter, distant crunch

trigger.name: Event::Ram (only with exactly two seats on the field)

sound.notes: Three or more seats never ram each other.

interactions.visual: the module and HUD slot change

sound.description: a hollow click and a cannon-ready clunk
sound.notes: Local seat. Also fires while an EMP keeps a special offline (another domain).

interactions.description: A press (an enemy's at the end of its tell) blasts a cone of sound out along the hull's facing. The dish flashes, the shooter kicks back a little and the front runs out over a third of a second.

trigger.name: Event::Fired { weapon: sonic_hammer } then Event::SonicBlast { slot, x, y, dir }

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1724 wave_arcs, module firing cell (tank.rs:1627 kick_sonic), weak ripple (simulation/sonic.rs:273), front dust

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1730 sonic::tell_arcs, module wind-up cells, off-screen ArrowKind::Windup (indicators.rs:1157)

interactions.description: The front reaches a hull of either side and takes up to 4 damage (falling off with distance), soaked by a shield if it has one. A hull it does not kill is knocked off its tracks.

interactions.visual: fx.rs:1166 hull flash, dust and stone chips

interactions.visual: fx.rs:1455 skid dust, sideways tread marks

sound.notes: Shared by every knock (rail recoil, rod ring, well fling). TankState::skid starts it; Game::skidding speed sets the volume.

interactions.description: Each pane the cone reaches dies outright when the front gets there, stopping the rays behind it.

trigger.name: Event::ObstacleDestroyed { material: Glass } (damage_obstacle with full health)

interactions.visual: fx.rs:935 tile_death, shards thrown along the wave line (docs/sonic-hammer.md:833)

interactions.visual: fx.rs:1040 sparks and a puff, flying drum arc, landing blast

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1734 bong::stun_marks (three circling blocks), hurt clip held

sound.description: A wobbly cartoon daze: a warbling ring of little chirps over its head

interactions.description: A lantern a seat set down in the cone is broken.
interactions.visual: fx.rs:1073 glass chips and sparks

sound.description: A small glass tinkle and the flame snuffed

interactions.description: Grenades on the ground or aloft in the cone are shoved along the wave's line at up to 260 px/s.

sound.description: A canister clattering and skittering away
