interactions.visual: fx.rs:1159 ring of shield sparks and smoke, shield_break_shock

sound.description: The shield domain's shatter
sound.notes: Plays in the same tick as systems_powerdown; duck one under the other.

interactions.description: On the way out the ring wipes whatever the special had in hand: a tell, a charge, a rod reticle, a minigun burst, a missile volley, a held flame. None of it logs anything.

trigger.name: Tank::disable clears tell, charge, reticle, minigun_burst, missile_volley, flame_held

interactions.visual: the charge ring, tell or reticle just vanishes

sound.description: The charging hum chokes off with a short electrical fizz
sound.notes: The sound system can only see the loop's state drop to zero.

interactions.description: A standing tower of either side (tesla, gun, bio) in the ring goes offline for 6 s: the tesla's charge is lost, a burst stops, its glow goes out and its top sags.

trigger.name: Event::TowerDisabled { x, y }; replica: tile_flags::DISABLED set

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1765 emp::sparks on the tower, glow off, Tower::droop

sound.description: A transformer clunk and a dying hum; for the tesla, a capacitor's discharge crack
sound.notes: The towers domain owns the tower's own hum; this edge stops it.

interactions.description: An EMP'd tower comes back when its outage runs out.
interactions.visual: glow back, sparks stop, sag eases

sound.description: A hum swelling back to its idle note

interactions.description: A missile of either side in the ring, the heli's rockets included, loses its motor, lock and trail and falls dead.
interactions.visual: render/missile.rs: no exhaust, no trail, nose falls (docs/emp-burst.md:774)

sound.description: The rocket's roar sputters and cuts, leaving a falling whistle
sound.notes: The missiles domain's flight loop must stop on dead.

interactions.description: A missile the EMP killed hits the ground with no blast: a puff of dust and pale sparks.
interactions.visual: fx.rs:1133 dust, EMP sparks, a splash if wet

sound.description: A dull metal clunk into dirt with a small fizz, comically anticlimactic

interactions.description: At night a pulse puts every lamp post on the map out for 10 s. They flicker back on over the last 0.6 s.

trigger.name: Game::lamps_out rising (RoundState::lamps_out), and falling back to 0

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1770 emp::lamp_sparks, posts drawn dark, two hashed blinks back on

sound.description: A field-wide electrical fzzt as every lamp dies at once, then buzzing flickers as they come back
sound.notes: Not positional (the whole map), or pan each post.

interactions.description: A gravity orb in flight that the ring reaches goes out with no well.
interactions.visual: swallow_show (render/game.rs:1827)

sound.description: The orb's hum chokes into a reversed pop

interactions.description: The pulse costs its shooter its own special for 3 s. The HUD flickers WPN OFFLINE and the trigger fires shells until it is back.
interactions.visual: HUD WPN OFFLINE flicker at 3.5 Hz (docs/emp-burst.md:837), module offline cell

sound.description: A ready chime when it comes back
sound.notes: Nothing marks the ready moment.

interactions.description: Holding the trigger with a slug and an open gate starts a 1.5 s charge. The hull drops to a crawl and a ring closes on it.

trigger.name: Event::ChargeStarted { weapon: gauss_rail }; replica: TankState::charge rising from 0

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1791 gauss::compose_charge (ring, motes, bore glow), module charge cells, HUD gauge

sound.description: A capacitor bank clunks in and a whine begins
sound.notes: A client's own charge is its predicted sandbox; the room's TankState::charge arrives late.

interactions.description: While held, the charge climbs to full. The shooter's hull crawls at a fifth of its speed.
interactions.visual: ring shrinking from 34 to 22 px, motes, bore light at night

sound.description: A climbing electromagnetic whine, pitch and loudness rising with progress
sound.notes: An enemy's charge is the dodge cue, so it should carry. BB-102's charge hum covers this one only.

interactions.description: At 1.5 s the charge is full: a release now fires. The ring holds and beats at 6 Hz.
interactions.visual: ring holding at 22 px, white glow core, module cell 5, HUD gauge white

sound.description: A crisp lock-on ping as the whine settles into a steady, throbbing tone
sound.notes: Edge-detect on the tick count against charge_rule().full_ticks().

interactions.description: A further 1.0 s held turns the charge overcharged: the slug will cut iron and the recoil will spin the hull round. Enemies never do this.
interactions.visual: white ring jumping a block either way, zigzags crackling off the bore, module cells 5/6 alternating at 10 Hz, HUD gauge blinking at 8 Hz

sound.description: An unstable screaming whine with arcs crackling: dangerous, about to blow

interactions.description: In the 0.6 s before the 3.5 s vent the ring flickers and steam wisps start off the module.
interactions.visual: ring flickering at 10 Hz, steam puffs, HUD gauge outline red

sound.description: Fast warning beeps over a hissing pressure build
sound.notes: Mostly for the shooter.

interactions.description: Held past 3.5 s the charge vents: no slug, a burst of steam, and the rail stays hot for 1.2 s.
interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1798 gauss::compose_end steam puffs and sparks

sound.description: A pressure-valve pssshh of steam and a dying whine
sound.notes: A client's own vent is drawn by PressShow::ChargeEnd, and the room's event follows: dedupe.

interactions.description: Let go before full and the charge fizzles: nothing fired, nothing spent, a few blocks drop off the bore. A charge lost to a wreck or another weapon's crate lapses the same way, sometimes with no event at all.

trigger.name: Event::ChargeEnded { end: Fizzled | Lapsed } (a wreck at mod.rs:2655 and an EMP at tank.rs:1752 log nothing)

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1798 compose_end (fizzle: four blocks; lapse: nothing)

sound.description: A soft electrical power-down blip, the whine sagging away

interactions.description: Released at full, a slug crosses the field down the gun line in one tick. A white frame flashes, an ionised trail lingers for 1.6 s, the muzzle burns and the screen ripples.

trigger.name: Event::Fired { weapon: gauss_rail } then Event::RailSlug { leg: 0, overcharged, pierced }

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1795 gauss::compose_slug (white frame, ion trail), muzzle flash, ripple, fx.rs:1244 bore sparks; frame light along the leg

sound.description: A massive electromagnetic CRACK: a thunderclap plus a hypersonic tearing whip down the lane, then the trail sizzling like ozone
sound.notes: Can be panned along the leg line. Legs past a portal are further RailSlug events. A client's own is drawn from PressShow::Rail.

interactions.description: The slug goes through every hull, bong, tower, wall, prop, tree and drone in its lane, in order, losing a fifth of its damage per hull and 5% per tile. Shields soak a whole hit.

trigger.name: Event::RailSlug::pierced [(x, y, Pierced::{Tank, Shield, Bong, Tile(Material), Drone})] plus Hit { cause: Rail } and ObstacleDestroyed per thing

interactions.visual: pierce bursts in compose_slug (render/game.rs:1795), compose_slug_lit chips (render/game.rs:1514), fx.rs:955 hit flash

sound.description: A rapid string of punches: a heavy armour punch-through per hull, a glassy zing off a shield, splintering per tile
sound.notes: Use the pierce list (ordered by distance), not the separate Hits. Stagger by distance from the muzzle and cap the count.

interactions.description: Iron, a volcano's cone, a training door or the field's edge stops the slug: it flashes, and a spark star splashes back.

trigger.name: Event::Hit { damage: 0, cause: Rail, target: Obstacle|Wall }

interactions.visual: stop spark star and glow in compose_slug; fx.rs:1253 splash back

sound.description: A deep, ringing anvil clang with a shower of sparks

interactions.description: An overcharged slug passes through iron and leaves it unharmed, with a spray of white-grey sparks.
interactions.visual: six white-grey sparks off the iron (compose_slug)

sound.description: A shrieking metal-on-metal shear

interactions.description: The release knocks the shooter back about a cell into a skid. An overcharged release throws it twice as far and spins the hull round half a turn.
interactions.visual: skid dust (fx.rs:1455), the hull and turret swinging round

sound.description: A heavy hull lurch, then hull_skid_scrape; overcharged adds a spinning track screech
sound.notes: A client's own recoil is predicted by its sandbox.

interactions.description: A seat standing in a charging enemy's lane (through cover, at any range) is in the line of fire.

trigger.name: indicators TankView::lane from PresentWorld::rail_trace while the enemy's charge runs

interactions.visual: off-screen Windup arrow with the lane ring (indicators.rs:1157); nothing on screen beyond the charge itself

sound.description: An urgent target-lock beeping that speeds up as the charge fills
sound.notes: Only for the local seat. The lane test already exists.

interactions.description: Up to twelve quadcopters hover in a ring round a tank carrying the swarm, bobbing, rotors turning, lamps blinking.
interactions.visual: game.rs:175 fpv::compose_halo, lamps at game.rs:242

sound.description: A soft swarm of tiny rotors, thickening with the count
sound.notes: One loop per tank, never per drone. Duck it under the engine.

interactions.description: An EMP settles the halo on the ground, rotors stopped, until the outage ends. On a wreck the drones tumble down dark.

trigger.name: halo eased from Tank::disabled; tumble from Tank::wreck_timer

interactions.visual: game.rs:175 halo settling and tumbling

sound.description: Rotors winding down to silence and a light plastic clatter; spooling back up when the disable ends

interactions.description: A press sends the top drone up out of the halo, locked on the nearest enemy in the seat's sight box or on the aim point.

trigger.name: Event::Fired { weapon: fpv_swarm } then Event::DroneLaunched { id, slot, target, bong }

interactions.visual: fx.rs:1097 dust ring round the slot, module launch cell, drone climbing (game.rs:229)

sound.description: A rotor spool-up whine and a lift-off whoosh
sound.notes: A client's own launch is drawn from PressShow::Drone.

interactions.description: An enemy's drone locked on a seat (or on the players' bong) homes on it until it dives. The lock is lost if the target is wrecked, goes under a tree's crown or teleports.
interactions.visual: off-screen ArrowKind::Drone for the locked seat (indicators.rs:1136); nothing on screen

sound.description: A thin warning tone for the targeted seat, rising as the drone nears, cut off when the lock breaks
sound.notes: Local seat only. DroneLockLost is NOT_SENT, so read the lock field.

interactions.description: A drone flies over walls and trees at 36 px and 230 px/s toward its aim.

trigger.name: Drone stage Launch or Cruise (DroneState::stage), speed and heading

interactions.visual: game.rs:229 compose_drone, shadow, fx.rs:1443 grey specks (the 'buzz a silent game can show'), lamp light

sound.description: A nasal, high FPV quad whine, pitch following speed, with Doppler as it passes
sound.notes: Per drone, so cap the voices and keep the nearest.

interactions.description: Within 64 px of its aim the drone commits and comes down in about 0.2 s. A drone still cruising after 6 s dives on the point ahead of it.
interactions.visual: lamp at 10 Hz, dive streak, blast ring on the ground for a seat's drone, arrow X turning white

sound.description: The rotor whine rising sharply into a kamikaze scream
sound.notes: The last warning before the burst.

interactions.description: The dive ends in a small blast: 8 damage at the centre to every hull and bong in 44 px, either side, tiles cracked and drums reacting.

trigger.name: Event::DroneBurst { crown: false } then the blast's Hit/Wreck/Shoved

interactions.visual: fx.rs:1101 explosion, drone_show fireball, ripple, impact flash, scorch (simulation/fpv.rs:357)

sound.description: A sharp small-charge pop with a crackle of plastic
sound.notes: Smaller than a missile's blast.

interactions.description: A dive ending in a tree's crown bursts in the leaves: the tree takes 4 damage and nothing under it is touched.
interactions.visual: fx.rs:1104 leaf chips, the fireball among the leaves, no scorch

sound.description: A muffled pop and the thrash of shredded leaves

interactions.description: A bullet, tesla arc, EMP ring, sonic wave, rail slug, rod or well core strikes a drone out of the air.
interactions.visual: fx.rs:1112 sparks in the cause's colour at the drone as drawn; the cause's own hit

sound.description: A plastic crack and a rotor stutter
sound.notes: Play at the drawn height. With fpv_drone_hits = 1 every bullet that hits downs it.

interactions.description: A downed drone tumbles, spinning and smoking, keeping some of its ground speed.
interactions.visual: X/+ spinning silhouette, smoke puffs (fx.rs:1433)

sound.description: A sputtering, descending whine with an irregular rotor wobble

interactions.description: A downed drone hits the ground a dud: no blast, a puff of dust and pale sparks.
interactions.visual: fx.rs:1123 dust, sparks, a splash if wet

sound.description: A light plastic crunch and a clatter of parts

interactions.description: Holding the trigger brings up a reticle 4 cells ahead. The hull brakes and stands while the stick steers it.

trigger.name: Event::ChargeStarted { weapon: rod_from_god }; replica: TankState::reticle and charge rising from 0

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1854 rod::compose_reticles (turning arcs and cross), designator line, module tracking cells, HUD gauge and prompt

sound.description: A targeting-computer chirp and a soft uplink carrier tone

interactions.description: Each stick press moves the reticle one cell, repeating every 0.06 s after a 0.18 s hold. It settles after 0.3 s at rest, and reads as a cancel on the hull's own cell.
interactions.visual: reticle moving; arcs closing as it settles; crossed out on its own cell

sound.description: A crisp UI tick per cell, a soft lock blip on the settle, and a dull 'cancel' tone on its own cell
sound.notes: Only for the local seat's reticle.

interactions.description: An enemy rod tank's reticle walks onto a seat, and a dotted red designator line runs from its lens to the target.

trigger.name: enemy Tank::reticle near a seat (TankState::reticle and charge)

interactions.visual: designator line, red reticle, off-screen Windup arrow in HUD_ROD_COLOR

sound.description: A laser-painting warning tone in the targeted seat's ears
sound.notes: Local seat only.

interactions.description: A tap (under 0.25 s), a release on the hull's own cell (the cancel) or a 10 s hold (the uplink times out) calls nothing and spends nothing.

trigger.name: Event::ChargeEnded { weapon: rod_from_god, end: Fizzled | Vented }

interactions.visual: the reticle just goes (no picture for the rod: simulation/gauss.rs:121)

sound.description: A downward two-note 'abort' blip; static for a timeout

interactions.description: Releasing a settled reticle calls a strike on its cell. A red beam drops onto a two-cell circle and a 3 s countdown starts. The call always lands.

trigger.name: Event::Fired { weapon: rod_from_god } then Event::RodCalled { id, cell, land }

interactions.visual: compose_call_ring closing, beam, circle, countdown (render/game.rs:1855), uplink module cell, red light at night

sound.description: A satellite-uplink confirmation (a digital chirp, a burst of radio static), then the beam's hum switching on
sound.notes: A client's own is drawn from PressShow::Rod as a provisional zone.

interactions.description: The red beam flickers for its first seconds, then holds steady. In its last second it widens to two blocks with a white core and the circle beats at 4 Hz.

trigger.name: rod Zone standing, time left = until - now (ZoneState::until)

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1855 rod::compose_calls; off-screen ArrowKind::Zone (indicators.rs:1146); minimap mark

sound.description: An eerie electric hum and a high whistle building in pitch toward the impact
sound.notes: Read on the zones' clock (Game::zone_lead) so the client's present matches the drawn count.

interactions.description: The whole seconds left (3, 2, 1) are drawn beside the circle, white in the last second.
interactions.visual: pyro::digits countdown beside the circle

sound.description: Three urgent beeps, the last higher
sound.notes: Positional, so a seat inside the circle hears it loudest.

interactions.description: The rod's descent is not simulated: the impact is a 0.05 s white column at the call's end. A real rod would shriek in just before.
interactions.visual: none before the column (render/game.rs:1857)

sound.description: A rising hypersonic shriek and sonic-boom crack that peaks on the impact
sound.notes: Schedule it ahead of until. The call is certain to land, so a scheduled cue is safe.

interactions.description: The rod lands: white column, screen flash, a big ripple and shake, fireball, dust ring, debris, rubble and scorch. On water it splashes, on ice it throws powder, and on a volcano's footprint it sets the eruption off.
interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1857 compose_column, render/game.rs:1544 compose_impact dust ring, rod_show fireball, screen flash, Shockwave rod_shock, ground flood light

sound.description: A colossal kinetic slam and sonic boom, the ground rumbling and debris pattering down after
sound.notes: Duck everything else under it for about a second. The ground kind is not in the event.

interactions.description: Every hull with any part in the circle, either side and the caller too, is wrecked whatever its shield. Bongs in the circle are killed.

trigger.name: Event::Hit { cause: Rod, killed: true } then Event::Wreck

interactions.visual: fx.rs:955 flash, the wreck's own explosion (fx.rs:988)

sound.description: A crumpling, compressing steel crunch beneath the wreck explosion
sound.notes: Plays in the same tick as rod_impact; mix under it.

interactions.description: Hulls between the circle and 6.5 cells are knocked out into a skid. Nothing is hurt.

trigger.name: Game::knock_from (Tank::skid); Event::Shoved for a seat's owned hull only

interactions.visual: skid dust (fx.rs:1455)

sound.description: The shared skid scrape
sound.notes: An enemy's knock carries no Hit.

interactions.description: Every breakable tile within 3.25 cells dies at once (not left burning). Drums go off where they stand, grenades go off, lanterns break, the oil trail lights, and iron stands sooted.

trigger.name: Event::ObstacleDestroyed per tile (DamageCause::Crush), Blast per drum, LanternBroken, FireStarted

interactions.visual: fx.rs:935 tile_death per tile, rubble ring decals

sound.description: One aggregated roar of collapsing masonry and splintering wood
sound.notes: Aggregate the up-to-45 tile deaths of one tick into one cue.

interactions.description: On dry ground the rod leaves a pit for the round. It smokes for 6 s and fills with water when it rains.

trigger.name: Event::RodImpact { crater: true }; CraterState; filling by rain via change_weather (no event)

interactions.visual: game.rs:601 rod::draw_crater, render/game.rs:1540 compose_crater_smoke, rain rings in a filled pit

sound.description: A low hiss and crackle of hot earth settling, fading over 6 s

interactions.description: A press sends a slow violet orb off the gun line at 150 px/s.
interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1821 well::compose_orb (swelling at the muzzle), module launch cell

sound.description: A deep, warbling whum as the projector lets go
sound.notes: Not a drawn-on-press kind, but a client flies its own orb from the press (round.rs OwnOrb), so the room's Fired arrives late.

interactions.description: The orb flies up to 320 px, bent by other wells, until it is anchored.
interactions.visual: compose_orb (disc, circling blocks, trail, glow)

sound.description: A throbbing, low warble that pulses faster as it slows
sound.notes: One per orb; at most one in flight per tank.

interactions.description: A second press, contact or the orb's range anchors it. A ring of violet snaps closed, the scene pinches inward, and a well forms over 0.4 s.

trigger.name: Event::WellAnchored { id, by: Press | Contact | Range }

interactions.visual: well_anchor_show compose_snap (render/game.rs:1825), inward ripple, module anchor cell

sound.description: A reversed-cymbal suck that ends in a hard snap, then a deep sub tone forming
sound.notes: A client's own anchor by press is predicted (round.rs:1153), and the room's event still reaches game.events: dedupe.

interactions.description: For 4 s everything within 4.5 cells falls toward the core. Hulls roll along their tracks and slide across them, tread marks swirl, grass bows and particles spiral in. In the last second the core beats.

trigger.name: well Zone stage Pulling (ZoneState::stage 1, until = collapse); start edge Forming to Pulling

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1817 compose_well (core, accretion ring, swirl, rim), drain marks, grass lean, fx spiral (fx.rs:2049), off-screen ArrowKind::Well

sound.description: A deep gravitational drone with swirling wind and low groans, pitch sinking and intensity rising, beating fast in the last second
sound.notes: Start on the stage edge and scale by strength at the listener.

interactions.description: Light hulls are dragged whichever way they face, heavy ones brace broadside. Hulls clumped at the core scrape against each other and against walls until the collapse.
interactions.visual: the hull moves; tread marks swirl

sound.description: Tracks dragging and slipping sideways, metal groaning, hulls grinding together in the clump
sound.notes: Nothing logs or draws the clump contact.

interactions.description: On the pull's first tick every drum in reach is torn out of its cell (no blast) and spirals in to circle the core, its fuse still burning.

trigger.name: Event::ObstacleDestroyed { material: Barrel } (no blast follows); WellDrumState

interactions.visual: held drums drawn lifted over their shadows circling (render/blast.rs FlyingDrum drawing)

sound.description: A metal groan and creak as the barrel tears loose, then a circling clank
sound.notes: A tile death keyed off ObstacleDestroyed{Barrel} would play an explosion that never happens.

interactions.description: Shells, bullets, plasma bolts and orbs in the pull turn toward the core at their own speed, and their tracers curve.
interactions.visual: curved tracer (well::curved_streak), rotated sprite

sound.description: The shot's whizz pitch-bending downward as it curves
sound.notes: Only if the projectiles domain gives shots a fly-by sound.

interactions.description: A shot, orb, missile or drone that reaches a pulling well's core is gone with no hit and no burst: a violet pop.

trigger.name: Event::Swallowed { what: Shell | Bullet | Plasma | Orb | Missile | Drone }

interactions.visual: compose_swallow ring closing (render/game.rs:1827)

sound.description: A short reversed gulp, a pop into silence
sound.notes: Rate-limit it: a minigun stream into a well logs one per bullet.

interactions.description: Grenades roll in and, within 26 px, are captured onto the ring to circle the core at 3 rad/s. At the collapse they are lobbed out along their radials.

trigger.name: Grenade::orbit set (capture), cleared at the collapse

interactions.visual: grenades drawn rolling round the ring

sound.description: Canisters clinking and rattling round in a circle

interactions.description: A bong in the pull cannot hop and slides toward the core flailing. It still bites.
interactions.visual: hurt clip held on its first frame, sliding

sound.description: A panicked squeal and wriggle

interactions.description: Crates slide toward the core at up to 60 px/s and are flung out at the collapse.

trigger.name: Pickup::drift (CrateState dx/dy) and the collapse slide

interactions.visual: crate drawn at Pickup::at()

sound.description: A wooden crate scraping over the ground

interactions.description: At the end of the pull, or the tick an EMP's ring reaches it, the well implodes and blows outward. Held drums go off together, every hull and bong in reach is flung and hurt (the owner's side too), grenades are lobbed out and what flies is turned away.

trigger.name: Event::WellCollapsed { id, early } then Blast { chained } per held drum, Hit { cause: Well }, Shoved

interactions.visual: fx.rs:1016 explosion Void, render/game.rs:1826 compose_collapse, collapse dust (render/game.rs:1525), well_shock ripple, screen flash

sound.description: A sudden silence-suck implosion, then an outward concussive BOOM with a whooshing pressure wave
sound.notes: Duck the held drums' blasts under it and aggregate them.

interactions.description: The collapse hurts every hull and bong in reach by up to 10, and each bong hops out along its line.

trigger.name: Event::Hit { cause: Well, target: Player | Enemy | Bong }

interactions.visual: fx.rs hull flash and the bong's hit (fx.rs:1179); skid dust

sound.description: A body-thud of the shove per hull; the bong's yelp

interactions.description: Taking an air crate calls a helicopter or a jet. The HUD box starts a 15 s count, or shows +1 queued behind a sortie already up.
interactions.visual: HUD air box: symbol, seconds, +N (docs/air-support.md:217)

sound.description: Radio squelch and a short 'air support inbound' voice line
sound.notes: Mostly for the calling seat.

interactions.description: The call's whole seconds tick down in amber, turning red over the last three. A queued call starts counting only when the seat's previous aircraft is gone.

trigger.name: AirCall::left ceil changing; AirState::arrive and stage AIR_WAITING to AIR_COUNTING (start_next_call)

interactions.visual: HUD air box digits (docs/air-support.md:224)

sound.description: Soft radio pips on the last three seconds

interactions.description: At zero the aircraft comes in from beyond an edge. armed says whether it found a target in the seat's sight box.

trigger.name: Event::AirSupportArrived { id, sortie, x, y, armed }

interactions.visual: game.rs:1074 paint_aircraft, minimap mark, off-screen ArrowKind::Aircraft (indicators.rs:1141)

sound.description: Rotors or a jet roar fading in from the edge, with a radio 'on station' (or 'no targets in sight')

interactions.description: The gunship escorts its tank 120 px off, swerving and braking at up to 320 px/s. Its stage moves through Inbound, Escort and Attack, nose on the nearest target.

trigger.name: Aircraft ground, heading and stage (AirState; a replica has no velocity)

interactions.visual: game.rs:1074 paint_aircraft (rotor blur), shadow, minimap mark blinking while it attacks

sound.description: A deep Apache rotor thump with turbine whine, panned and attenuated by distance
sound.notes: A replica must take speed from successive positions.

interactions.description: Every 1.6 s, with its tank near and its nose on the target, two seeker rockets leave its pods. The salvo is held while a friend is in reach.

trigger.name: Event::AirSalvo { id, x, y } (no Fired for the missiles); replica: new MissileState ids near the heli

interactions.visual: muzzle flash at the pods (simulation/air_support.rs:247), the missiles' climb and smoke trails

sound.description: Two quick whooshing rocket launches off the pods
sound.notes: The missiles domain's launch sound, keyed off Fired, never plays for these.

interactions.description: Enemy bullets crossing the heli's strike box count hits. Below 16 nothing but an impact flash shows.
interactions.visual: impact flash only (simulation/mod.rs:5247)

sound.description: Bullets pinging and sparking off the airframe
sound.notes: A replica cannot see it at all: hits are not on AirState.

interactions.description: Sixteen bullets, or any other air strike (an EMP, the seat's own included), bring the heli down. A fireball where it falls, which hurts nothing.
interactions.visual: fx.rs:1012 sparks in the air and the wreck burst, aircraft_crash_show fireball and ripple

sound.description: A failing rotor's lurching whine, an explosion and the crunch of the crash
sound.notes: Stop heli_rotor_thump on this event (no AirSupportLeft follows).

interactions.description: The heli turns for home with its rockets spent or its seat gone; the jet out of passes, after its circle, or capped at 25 s. Each flies off the edge and is gone. A call whose seat left the round is spent the same way.
interactions.visual: the aircraft flying off the field; HUD pips dark

sound.description: Engine and rotor fading out with a radio 'Winchester, RTB'

interactions.description: The jet flies at a constant 264 px/s in straights and banked arcs, through Inbound, Attack, Loiter (extend, turn back, circle its seat) and Egress, and goes round when a run is too tight.

trigger.name: Aircraft ground, heading, bank and stage (AirState)

interactions.visual: game.rs:1074 paint_aircraft with banked_span, shadow sliding into the turn

sound.description: A whining turbofan roar with a strong Doppler sweep on each flyby; the tone rises in hard banks

interactions.description: Every fresh muzzle flash spits sparks down the shot's line and a wisp of gun smoke; online the own seat's flash is put on at the press.
interactions.visual: fx.rs:1297-1301 spark cone + smoke; shockwave ripple render

sound.description: the alternative fire hook that is already right online
sound.notes: The flash carries no weapon and no slot; fx skips flamethrower nozzles by distance (fx.rs:1294). Hook the predictor's take_muzzles() for the own seat and the room's Fired for everyone else instead.

interactions.description: A fish darts from a hull on the bank, a shot over or beside the water, or a blast.
interactions.visual: render::fish::draw_fish (glint while darting)

sound.description: a tiny plip under the surface
sound.notes: Only when the water is near the listener and quiet; never under ice.

interactions.description: A sonic wave's front, a rod's impact or a well's collapse throws fish onto dry ground, where they flop and hop back into the water.
interactions.visual: render::fish (flopping fish on the bank)

sound.description: wet slap-slap of a fish on mud, a splash as it hops back
sound.notes: A replica throws the same fish off the same wave, so it plays the same online.

interactions.description: Whenever a local seat's hull loses at least hurt_min_damage in a step, from any cause, its own view shakes or is shoved away from the blow, its edge pulses red and its health number ticks.

trigger.name: Tank::damage rose by >= hurt_min_damage between two read frames (strength = lost / hurt_full_damage, direction blow_of)

interactions.visual: feedback.rs pulse_look (edge band), tick_look (HUD number, render/hud.rs:236-241), shake/shove (follow.rs SeatTank::shove)

sound.description: a close, dry metal clang inside the turret with a low thump, panned from the blow's direction
sound.notes: Head-locked layer on top of the world's impact sound. The same diff works on a replica (app.rs:2774). One per seat per step; in a couch split pan L/R by the half.

interactions.description: The health number turns orange under hud_warn_threshold (0.34) and red under hud_critical_threshold (0.104); nothing else signals it.
interactions.visual: render/hud.rs:227-265 number colour

sound.description: a two-tone warning on crossing orange, a slow heartbeat or alarm loop while red
sound.notes: Own seat only; duck it under the music; hysteresis so a heal across the line does not chatter.

interactions.description: When a local seat's wreck count goes up, an offline round at full motion holds the step clock for kill_hitstop_seconds.
interactions.visual: the round freezes for a few frames (app.rs:2490)

sound.description: a short punchy 'got him' accent layered on the wreck explosion
sound.notes: Fire on the by_seat increment, not on the hold, so it also plays online where the hold is off (app.rs:2774 passes hold false). Do not freeze audio during the hold - duck the bed instead.

interactions.description: The blow that decides a local round is held for round_hitstop_seconds, then the round runs at round_slowmo_scale for round_slowmo_seconds, easing back over its last 40 %.
interactions.visual: app.rs:2490 scaled clock; render keeps the frame

sound.description: the world's sound pitch- and tempo-bent down with a low-pass, a bass drop on the hold
sound.notes: Drive the mixer's time stretch from Session::time_scale; the online round's end has no slow-mo (since_end reads the local game).

interactions.description: The round ends in a win: the finale plays with nothing over the world, then YOU WIN (or TRAINING DONE!) eases in.
interactions.visual: render/game.rs:497-503 title; render/hud.rs:727-800 result

sound.description: victory jingle after the finale, timed to the verdict easing in
sound.notes: Start on the verdict edge (since_end >= finale), not on the event, so the finale's blasts are heard first.

interactions.description: The round ends in a loss: every seat wrecked or the players' bong dead (a same-frame tie is a loss). The screen only says YOU LOSE.
interactions.visual: render/game.rs:497-503 YOU LOSE in maroon; friendly-fire line hud.rs:1467-1476

sound.description: defeat sting; a different one when the bong died than when the tanks did
sound.notes: The reason has to be derived from round state today.

interactions.description: After round_finale_seconds the end screen fades in over round_verdict_fade_seconds; a press during the finale skips to it.

trigger.name: Game::since_end crossing EndBeats.finale; skip_finale on a press

interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1229-1255 dim + eased title drop

sound.description: a swell under the title drop
sound.notes: restart_timer travels to a replica, so the beat lands on the room's clock.

interactions.description: A level's end screen counts down 'NEXT LEVEL IN 3' / 'PLAY AGAIN IN 3'; free play shows 'Restarting in N...', a room 'Back to the lobby in N...'.
interactions.visual: the counted-down button's label

sound.description: soft tick per second, a brighter one on the last
sound.notes: No per-second event; edge on the whole-second value.

interactions.description: LEVELS, PLAY AGAIN and NEXT LEVEL / BACK TO LEVEL 1, or Enter; a press while the screen eases in or fades out is swallowed.
interactions.visual: verdict lift-out (mode.rs:709-721)

sound.description: confirm click, then a whoosh as the verdict lifts
sound.notes: A swallowed press (not verdict_ready) could give a soft 'not yet' tick.

interactions.description: The kept end screen dissolves into the next round over round_dissolve_seconds; a mid-round restart cuts in.
interactions.visual: render::dissolve

sound.description: a soft whoosh that clears the previous round's tails
sound.notes: The moment to stop every loop of the old round; fx clears on RoundStarted (fx.rs:916) and a sound layer must do the same.

interactions.description: A round opens frozen behind its mission banner (PROTECT THE BONG!, LEVEL n / title) for mission_banner_seconds, or until a seat moves or fires, then the banner fades and the round goes live.

sound.description: a mission sting under the banner and a 'go' hit on the frame the round goes live
sound.notes: Training's banner reads TRAINING. Online the opening RoundStarted may never reach game.events.

interactions.description: A field map's first round on screen opens on the whole map for about a second, then zooms fast down to the follow view (into the split for a couch pair apart).
interactions.visual: app.rs:2678-2701 the zoom's mapping

sound.description: rising whoosh as the view dives onto the tank
sound.notes: A room's round has no banner and no shot. Cut under reduced motion: skip the whoosh too.

interactions.description: During the breather the banner shows WAVE N or FINAL WAVE; it vanishes when the wave is called and the gates start to blink.
interactions.visual: render/game.rs:1273-1276 banner; indicators gate blink

sound.description: a klaxon or war horn, heavier for the final wave
sound.notes: The event has no 'final' flag; the HUD reads wave_status. A breather countdown (next_in) is never shown or ticked.

interactions.description: P or the pause button flips Game::paused inside the next step; the icon swaps and the frame is washed, and the particle layer freezes.
interactions.visual: render/hud.rs:573-592 icon + wash; render/game.rs:1281-1287 PAUSED

sound.description: pause blip and the game bed ducked to silence; unpause blip and a short swell back
sound.notes: Every loop must pause with fx_runs; no pause exists in a room.

interactions.description: R, the RESTART corner button (no-keyboard builds) or the dev panel re-inits the round at once, mid-play, paused or on the end screen.
interactions.visual: the round cuts in; camera glides from the wreck (follow.rs:89-96)

sound.description: a quick rewind blip
sound.notes: Kill every loop and tail; the frame counter going back is the same signal fx uses (fx.rs:908-910).

interactions.description: The players dialog, the level select and a kept-map question stop Game::update being called; nothing in the simulation knows.
interactions.visual: the dialog over a frozen round

sound.description: a soft panel open; the game bed held under a low-pass while it is up
sound.notes: Same loop-pause rule as pause; never pause a room's replica.

interactions.description: The players button opens 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYERS; ONE, TWO, 1, 2, Enter (switch), Esc or a press outside answers or closes it.
interactions.visual: render/hud.rs:528-529 button lit; dialog panel

sound.description: two-step select, a 'second player in' chime on TWO
sound.notes: Hidden on iOS/Android.

interactions.description: FILE's REVERT TO ORIGINAL, or a modified copy whose shipped original changed, asks a yes/no question over the round or the builder.
interactions.visual: render/hud.rs:683 dialog

sound.description: attention tone on open, confirm / cancel clicks
sound.notes: The only confirmation in the game.

interactions.description: The level button, LEVELS or Esc opens the select; pointer or arrows move focus, Enter or a press starts an open tile, BACK or a press outside closes. A press on a locked tile does nothing.
interactions.visual: render/level_select.rs:66-97 focus edge, padlock, tick

sound.description: focus tick per move, a start fanfare, a dull locked thunk
sound.notes: The locked press returns Stay with no other feedback (level_select.rs:235).

interactions.description: BUILD / Tab, PLAY, PLAY HERE and BACK move the window between play and the builder; the plates slide while the worlds cross-fade over ui_swap_seconds.

trigger.name: Session::press_build / play / play_here / back / toggle -> start_swap

interactions.visual: mode.rs Swap progress; take_swap_picture (app.rs:2330)

sound.description: a sliding-plates whoosh; PLAY an engine-start, BACK a reverse
sound.notes: Switch the ambience/music bed here; the round paused behind the builder keeps its loops silent.

interactions.description: Corner buttons: Pause, Restart (no keyboard), Level, Build, Online, Leave (in a room), Players, Lamp. A press on a cluster is claimed and never a tank order.
interactions.visual: frame/icon state only (render/hud.rs:528-613)

sound.description: one crisp UI click family for every corner button
sound.notes: Group them: one click, a distinct one for Leave. There is no hover or held state to sound.

interactions.description: The lamp key or the lamp row's count asks to set a lantern; with none left the lantern is drawn dark and the press does nothing.

trigger.name: Intent::lamp with lamps_left == 0 (no event); a success is Event::LanternSet

interactions.visual: dark lantern symbol

sound.description: dull empty click
sound.notes: The set-down itself is the world domain's LanternSet cue.

interactions.description: The shell count turns orange then red by the same thresholds as health; the ring pips go Part then Empty.
interactions.visual: count colour, ring pips

sound.description: a short low-ammo beep at red
sound.notes: Own seat only.

interactions.description: At 0 the weapon symbol dims; a special that runs out silently turns back into shells. A trigger pull on an empty gun fires nothing and logs nothing.

trigger.name: tank.special() going None / weapon_ammo reaching 0; a refused press has no event

interactions.visual: dimmed symbol, symbol swap to the shell

sound.description: a hollow click on an empty trigger; a 'weapon spent' clunk as the special drops back to shells
sound.notes: Online the predictor already gates a refused press (predict.rs:26-32) and can say so locally.

interactions.description: Taking a weapon pickup swaps the HUD symbol and colour with no flash; the crate's opening animation plays at the pickup.

trigger.name: Event::PickupCollected { slot: own seat, kind: special } + HUD symbol change

interactions.visual: CrateOpen symbol flying into the tank; HUD symbol swap

sound.description: a mechanical load-and-lock per weapon, plus its name voiced (optional)
sound.notes: The pickup's world sound belongs to the pickups domain; this is the own-seat HUD layer.

interactions.description: An EMP takes a seat's special offline: WPN OFFLINE flickers at emp_hud_flicker_hz with the symbol and count dimmed, until it comes back.
interactions.visual: WPN OFFLINE flicker

sound.description: crackling static loop on the own seat, a reboot chirp when it returns
sound.notes: The 'back online' edge has no event anywhere.

interactions.description: The gauss gauge fills in its accent colour, turns white at Full (ready), blinks at 8 Hz when overcharged and outlines red inside VENT_WARN_SECONDS before it vents.

trigger.name: Tank::charge held crossing Full / overcharge / vent - VENT_WARN_SECONDS

interactions.visual: gauge colour, blink, red outline

sound.description: a bright ping at full, a rising warble when overcharged, a fast beep before the vent
sound.notes: The hum itself is the weapons domain's loop; ChargeStarted is NOT_SENT, so online the start is a TankState::charge edge (the replica counts it up, simulation/mod.rs:3301-3305; own seat set_seat_charge present.rs:389).

interactions.description: After a call the air row counts whole seconds in amber, red at 3 or fewer; queued sorties show +N.

trigger.name: Event::AirSupportCalled, then air_calls() arrive time (whole-second edges)

interactions.visual: air row seconds, +N

sound.description: radio 'inbound' squawk on the call, three countdown pips at 3-2-1
sound.notes: The aircraft's own sounds are the air-support domain's.

interactions.description: In the air the row shows one amber pip per salvo or pass, turning grey as each is spent; the symbol goes unlit when the last is.

trigger.name: aircraft() salvos/passes left decreasing (Event::AirSalvo is NOT_SENT)

interactions.visual: pip greying

sound.description: a small radio click per pass spent, 'Winchester' on the last

interactions.description: Speed-up, shield and heat-shield gauges drain to empty with no warning; the symbol dims and the heat-shield row disappears.

trigger.name: speed_boost_timer, shield_charge(), heat_shield_fraction reaching 0 (no event; ShieldBroken only for the shield's charge)

interactions.visual: gauges

sound.description: a fading power-down warble a couple of seconds before it ends, a soft clunk when it does
sound.notes: Own seat only.

interactions.verb: comes down to the last enemy
interactions.description: The enemies-left count just reads 1; nothing marks the moment.
interactions.visual: the number

sound.description: a tension sting, the music thinning to a pulse
sound.notes: Not on Hunt, whose win is the enemy bong.

interactions.description: The bong's gauge drains with no low-health cue.

trigger.name: bong health_fraction() under a threshold (none exists)

interactions.visual: gauge

sound.description: an alarm in the bong's own voice
sound.notes: Protect missions lose on the bong; this is a design hole as much as a sound.

interactions.description: Another seat's chip turns grey when its tank is wrecked; nothing else.
interactions.visual: chip greys

sound.description: a radio 'man down' call, panned to the wreck if off-screen
sound.notes: The bong says BONG_DOWN in training only (bubble.rs:103-107).

interactions.description: An enemy lined up with the seat inside its sight fires: the lane ring flashes white; while it only lines up, the ring pulses at indicator_pulse_hz.

trigger.name: Event::Fired { slot >= first_enemy } with lined_up(at, facing, seat, sight) -> Note::Fired { at_seat: true }

interactions.visual: indicator lane ring flash

sound.description: a sharp directional crack or whistle from the shooter's side, louder when it is off-screen
sound.notes: The one off-screen threat warning the HUD already computes; pan from the indicator's direction. Online the enemy's Fired arrives at render time, which matches its drawn shot.

interactions.verb: marks where the hit came from
interactions.description: A shot, ram, bite, sonic wave or an enemy missile bursting on the seat draws a hit arc pointing at its source.

trigger.name: Event::Hit{Player, is_shot} / Ram / BongBite / MissileBlast near the seat -> Note::Hit { from }

interactions.visual: hit arc on the own tank

sound.description: pan for the self_hit stinger
sound.notes: Not a separate sound: it supplies the direction feedback.rs's blow_of does not have for rams and bites.

interactions.description: An enemy's special wind-up (tell) gets an arrow that blinks faster as it nears firing.

trigger.name: Tank::tell (TellStarted is NOT_SENT; the replica runs tell.left down, simulation/mod.rs:3286-3288)

interactions.visual: wind-up arrow blink

sound.description: an accelerating beep from the arrow's direction
sound.notes: The tell's own on-field sound is the AI/weapons domain's; this is the off-screen warning.

interactions.description: A tank starting to roll in, or entering, flashes its gate's arrow and minimap mark at 3 Hz.
interactions.visual: gate arrow and minimap blink

sound.description: a distant gate clank or alert from the gate's direction
sound.notes: The gate's own sound belongs to the waves domain.

interactions.description: A pickup respawning anywhere shows no arrow, no minimap mark and no particle: the crate is simply there.

trigger.name: Event::PickupRespawned { kind, x, y } (fx ignores it)

interactions.visual: none

sound.description: a soft supply-drop chime panned and attenuated by distance
sound.notes: The only cue a player would get.

interactions.description: The view cuts instead of panning when the followed seat goes through a portal or comes in through a gate, when the round on screen changes, when it hands over to a seat more than a screen away, or when the seat moved further than it could drive.

trigger.name: Event::Teleported / TankEntered for a local seat; Follow::cut

interactions.visual: the view jumps

sound.description: no cue: the listener jumps with the view and spatial voices crossfade
sound.notes: Listener placement rule, not a sound.

interactions.description: Two couch seats share a view on their midpoint while both sight boxes fit; apart, the screen splits along their bisector, each half following its own seat.
interactions.visual: split divider

sound.description: no cue; where the one listener sits for two views
sound.notes: One output for two players; see G28.

interactions.verb: hands the view to a teammate
interactions.description: A wrecked seat, or one back in a gate lane, keeps the view for camera_spectate_delay_seconds, then the nearest live teammate has it; a couch seat down hands the screen to the other.

trigger.name: follow: seat wreck held past camera_spectate_delay_seconds

interactions.visual: pan to the teammate

sound.description: own-seat layers (engine, self_hit) stop; the world muffles slightly while spectating
sound.notes: The listener moves to the spectated hull.

interactions.description: Blasts' shockwaves, slams' jolts and hurt shakes move the picture; reduced motion leaves every shake undrawn.
interactions.visual: shockwave::camera_shake_with

sound.description: a low sub rumble scaled by the shake's punch
sound.notes: Gives reduced-motion players the weight the shake no longer shows; drive from the same Shockwave remaining().

interactions.description: The first touch on the steer half sets the stick's origin, which follows the thumb past the follow radius; lifting it stops the tank.
interactions.visual: touch.rs:378-383 base and knob

sound.description: no sound; the engine's response is the feedback
sound.notes: A haptic tick would serve better; none exists.

interactions.description: Any touch on the fire half is a one-frame press, a hold is held fire; each tap leaves a 0.25 s ripple.
interactions.visual: tap ripple

sound.description: the weapon's fire cue covers it; a dry click when the press is refused
sound.notes: Same refusal gap as the keyboard.

interactions.description: In a training round the bong speaks each beat's lines, reacts to being hit (OW, KIT), to an enemy hit in the enemy beat, to a heal, a bite, a minigun pickup and a seat wrecked, says READY when done, and nudges after training_nudge_seconds of silence.

trigger.name: BongVoice line becoming Some (queue pop), from training_status beats and events

interactions.visual: render/bubble.rs speech bubble

sound.description: a gibberish voice blurt per line in the bong's own timbre
sound.notes: Training maps are never hosted.

interactions.description: A line's words appear one at a time at training_line_words_per_second.
interactions.visual: words appearing

sound.description: a soft blip per word, pitched by the bong
sound.notes: Animal-Crossing style; cap to the word rate.

interactions.description: HOST or JOIN dials the room: REACHING THE ROOM, then ASKING FOR A SEAT once the socket is open.
interactions.visual: lobby Waiting face text

sound.description: a soft radio-tuning loop while connecting
sound.notes: No Event; edge on Phase.

interactions.description: The room's Welcome opens YOUR ROOM / IN THE ROOM (or the round itself if it has started); a host sees the code and QR appear.
interactions.visual: lobby Room face, code and QR

sound.description: a 'link up' chirp
sound.notes: A protocol mismatch is only a note (round.rs:785) after the phase advanced.

interactions.description: The room refuses with a Refusal code (NoSuchRoom, RoomFull, AlreadyStarted, ServerFull, ServerDraining, Kicked, GraceOver, NotReady, ...); the text shows as the lobby sub-line or a suffix on the status line, and a following close overwrites it.
interactions.visual: text only

sound.description: a negative buzz; a harsher one for Kicked

interactions.description: The socket closes, or the room stops answering pings for 5 s, or is not reached in 15 s: the lobby reads THE ROOM IS GONE; mid-round the field freezes or extrapolates under an OFFLINE line and the window stays Online.
interactions.visual: OFFLINE status text; lobby Closed face

sound.description: a radio-static cut and the game bed dropping out
sound.notes: Every loop must stop: the replica will never send the events that would end them.

interactions.description: With no snapshot ahead the status reads WAITING FOR THE ROOM; hulls extrapolate 150 ms then dead-blend to a stop, shots fly on along their heading, and no events flow while render time holds.
interactions.visual: status line text

sound.description: no cue; loops should hold their last state then fade over the dead-blend
sound.notes: When it recovers, a backlog of events can land on one frame (G4).

interactions.description: Another player joining, leaving, readying, going AWAY or coming back, or the host seat moving, arrives only as a whole roster; mid-round nothing shows a teammate dropping.

trigger.name: Lobby::Roster diff of RosterSeat { seat, nick, chassis, ready, connected }

interactions.visual: lobby row state text (HOST/READY/WAITING/AWAY); nothing mid-round

sound.description: a join chime, a leave tone, a ready tick per seat
sound.notes: Diff the roster in OnlineRound each poll.

interactions.description: The host's START (or REMATCH) sends Lobby::Started; the Welcome that follows hands the window from the Lobby to Online with no countdown.

trigger.name: ClientEvent::Started, then Phase::Playing on the Welcome

interactions.visual: the round appears

sound.description: a 3-2-1-go the room does not have; at least a start sting
sound.notes: The replica's opening RoundStarted may be lost (G19).

interactions.description: RoundEnded reaches the replica and the end screen counts 'Back to the lobby in N'; Lobby::Ended then switches the window to the lobby the frame it is polled, with ROUND WON. REMATCH...
interactions.visual: lobby rematch face

sound.description: a soft transition back to the lobby bed
sound.notes: The last interpolation delay's snapshots are never drawn: tails of the round's last sounds get cut.

interactions.description: Host, Join, Back, Map/Mission prev/next (wrapping), the code keypad Key(i) and Del, Confirm, Ready (no un-ready), Start/REMATCH (only when can_start), Leave, Kick(row); typing, Backspace, Enter, Esc.
interactions.visual: button state; disabled buttons are not hit

sound.description: the shared click family; keypad clicks; a dull thunk for a disabled button or a sixth code character
sound.notes: A refused 6th character is silent today (lobby.rs:509-515); a bad code shows text only (rooms.rs:212).

interactions.description: LEAVE in the corner or Esc sends Lobby::Leave, closes, and drops the window back to the local round exactly where it stood.
interactions.visual: the local round reappears

sound.description: a 'link down' blip; the replica's loops stop and the local round's resume frozen

interactions.description: Online the own seat's shot is drawn on the frame of the press: muzzle ripple, turret kick, then the provisional flies by its own state machine; press-drawn weapons (laser beam, sonic wave, EMP ring, rail slug, drone, rod, orb, anchor) are drawn from the predicted pose.
interactions.visual: draw_muzzle, kick_seat, draw_beam, draw_press_show, draw_rail_press (present.rs:307-372)

sound.description: the own weapon's fire cue, played here online
sound.notes: Then skip the room's Fired for this seat; a press nobody claims within refusal_after was refused (predict.rs:63-64).

interactions.description: A provisional stops at the first tile, field edge, tank or bong (or opposing shell) it meets in the drawn world and plays its impact at once; damage stays the room's.
interactions.visual: draw_impact; watch_impacts for the provisional's own impact frames

sound.description: the impact, played where the picture stops the shot
sound.notes: The room's Hit (with material and kill) arrives ~RTT later; play only the kill/damage confirm then.

interactions.description: Each frame the interpolator hands over the events of every snapshot render time has reached; a frame that steps over several hands them all over at once, and cosmetic events more than 250 ms late are dropped.
interactions.visual: fx.observe on shown() once a frame (app.rs:2762)

sound.description: the online feed every world cue plays from
sound.notes: Dedupe on game.frame() as fx does; cap per frame.

interactions.description: A category icon, the eraser, a dropdown row, the folded palette or the mouse wheel over a category selects a tool; brush shapes PEN/RECT/FILL/SCATTER/SELECT/STAMPS; DAY and FIT toggles; popups FILE, category list, TOOLS, BRUSH, MAP, CHECK, STAMPS open one at a time and close on Esc or a press outside.
interactions.visual: amber outline on the category, status line 'WALL: BRICK' (mod.rs:3514)

sound.description: a tactile select click; a soft pop for popups opening and closing
sound.notes: The outside press that closes a popup does nothing else - a close sound tells the player why.

interactions.description: PEN paints along an edge-joined line, so a fast drag can change several cells in one frame; one undo step per stroke. A singleton (start, P2, bongs) moves instead of adding a second.

trigger.name: begin_stroke / drag_to / paint (a cell really changed) / finish_stroke_changes

interactions.visual: the cell and its ground repaint; hover outline (render.rs:823-826)

sound.description: a marker-scratch tick per cell, pitched by material (brick knock, water slosh, grass rustle)
sound.notes: Rate-limit per frame; a singleton move is a 'hop'.

interactions.description: The ERASE tool, the right button or toggle-erase on a cell that already holds the brush clears cells per cell, like PEN.
interactions.visual: cell disappears; red loupe outline (render.rs:1552); red RECT wash (render.rs:1479)

sound.description: a rubber rub per cell
sound.notes: Rate-limit.

interactions.description: FILL floods on press (hundreds of cells at once); RECT lays its rectangle on release; SCATTER lays a hashed footprint per cell crossed; FOREST plants per cell then re-picks the trees on release.
interactions.visual: cells; RECT preview (render.rs:1477-1497); scatter footprint (render.rs:1498-1506)

sound.description: a bucket-pour whoosh scaled by cells changed; a seed scatter; a leaf rustle for FOREST
sound.notes: A too-large FILL is refused with status text only (mod.rs:2292).

interactions.description: Drag a rectangle to select, lift and carry it cell by cell, drop to commit (unmade if dropped where it started); COPY, CUT, DELETE, FLIP are one press each; Esc or a second finger cancels a drag.

trigger.name: begin_select_drag / lift / drag_over / drop / copy / cut / delete / flip / cancel_drag

interactions.visual: marching ants (render.rs:1435, 2198); status count on copy/cut

sound.description: pick-up and set-down, scissors for CUT, a shutter for COPY, a card flip for FLIP, a step tick while carrying
sound.notes: Copy/cut/delete/flip with nothing selected are silent no-ops (mod.rs:2444, 2465, 2482).

interactions.description: Paste or a stamp row starts a see-through ghost that follows the pointer; a press, tap or PLACE puts it down as one step; cancel drops it; the selection can be kept as a stamp.
interactions.visual: faint ghost (render.rs:1449)

sound.description: a rubber-stamp thud on place
sound.notes: Paste with an empty clipboard is silent (mod.rs:2512); skipped singletons or off-map cells too (mod.rs:2608, 2613).

interactions.description: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, the bar buttons, or a two/three-finger tap step the 200-deep history; an empty stack returns false with only the buttons drawn dim.

gaps.title: Fired is one per trigger pull, not one per projectile
gaps.detail: A twin barrel's second shell or bolt (0.05 s later), every minigun round after the first of a burst and every missile tube after the first leave from tick_queued_shots with no event. A replica also draws no muzzle ripple for a twin's second shell (apply.rs puts one at the first barrel only, src/net/apply.rs:676).
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect new projectile ids in sample_world (the Fx::watch_casings pattern, src/fx.rs:1345), or add Event::ShotLaunched { id, slot, kind, x, y } in spawn_pending (src/simulation/mod.rs:4805), kept off the wire for bullets.

gaps.title: The minigun's Fired comes before its first round
gaps.detail: A pull on barrels at rest logs Fired at once and the first round leaves minigun_spinup_seconds (0.1 s) later; a gunshot keyed on Fired is early, and a held trigger logs a Fired every 0.3 s mid-stream.
gaps.suggested_fix: Start the motor on Fired, play rounds off actual launches (G1), never a report on Fired itself.

gaps.title: Minigun spin-up and spin-down are state only
gaps.detail: Tank::minigun_spin rises over 0.1 s and falls over 0.6 s with no event, including the run-down after the gun goes dry. A replica rebuilds the spin from each room Fired (Tank::kick_minigun), not from the room's own state.
gaps.suggested_fix: Drive a motor loop from Tank::minigun_spin in sample_world; acceptable as is.

gaps.title: Casings live only in fx and report no bounce
gaps.detail: Cases are thrown by fx.rs from rand::rng, culled outside the views and capped; Casings::tick bounces them up to twice and returns nothing, so a tinkle has no hook.
gaps.suggested_fix: Have Casings::tick return the bounces (position, strength) for the sound layer, or schedule a tinkle a fixed delay after each eject.

gaps.title: Ricochet says neither what bounced nor off what
gaps.detail: One Event::Ricochet { slot, x, y, heading } covers a shell off iron or a volcano, a shell or bullet off a drum or a tower (deflect_chance) and a bullet glancing off a tank, a bong or any tile (try_glance). A heavy clang, a drum bong and a bullet's zing cannot be told apart.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add kind (shell/bullet) and off (a HitTarget, or Material/tank/bong) to Event::Ricochet and WireEvent::Ricochet, or a separate Event::Glanced.

gaps.title: Deflected lacks the projectile kind
gaps.detail: A shield bouncing a shell, a bullet or a plasma bolt logs the same Event::Deflected { slot, x, y }.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add the shot kind (or id) to Event::Deflected.

gaps.title: Minigun streams flood Hit, Deflected, Ricochet and ShotTeleported
gaps.detail: 30 rounds a second per gun, each its own Event::Hit; against a shield 30 Deflected a second; ~1.5 glances a second; several guns plus gun towers multiply it.
gaps.suggested_fix: Voice caps per (target, cause) and a 30-50 ms aggregation window in the sound layer; pitch-walk copies.

gaps.title: Event::Hit never says who fired
gaps.detail: Hit carries target, cause, damage and point but no shooter, so the shooter cannot hear a hit marker, and a teammate's shell, spall or grenade (full friendly fire since BB-188) sounds like an enemy's. Tank::hit_by_seat exists but is cleared every frame and is not on the wire.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add by: Option<u16> (Owner slot) to Event::Hit and WireEvent::Hit (bump PROTOCOL_VERSION).

gaps.title: Wreck lacks the killer and the cause
gaps.detail: Event::Wreck { slot, x, y } does not say who wrecked it (Tank::wrecked_by, last_hit_by) or by what, so a kill confirmation needs a RoundStats diff, which a replica may not have.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add by: Option<u16> and cause to Event::Wreck.

gaps.title: MissileLocked never travels, and NOT_SENT does not list it
gaps.detail: from_event returns None for MissileLocked, but it is not among the 20 names in NOT_SENT; MissileState carries no target either, so a replica cannot know a missile is locked on its seat.
gaps.suggested_fix: Send MissileLocked (or a lock code in MissileState, as DroneState.lock does) and add it to NOT_SENT if it stays unsent.

gaps.title: No warning that an enemy missile is locked on a seat
gaps.detail: The lock exists (target slot) but nothing draws or signals it to the seat; only a seat's own blast ring shows a dive, and enemy missiles ring nothing.
gaps.suggested_fix: A lock-warning cue for the targeted seat off MissileLocked, plus G10 for online.

gaps.title: Missile stages have no events
gaps.detail: Climb to Seek, Chase, the dive commit and the max-flight commit are state only; MissileState has no stage, so a replica can only guess from height.
gaps.suggested_fix: Drive the motor from speed/height in sample_world; add a stage byte to MissileState if the dive whistle matters.

gaps.title: Grenade landings, bounces, hull kicks and water entry are silent
gaps.detail: Grenade::roll_pulled hops, reflects off boxes and is pushed by hulls with no event; GrenadeState has no velocity, so a replica must infer from position deltas.
gaps.suggested_fix: Return a bounce record (kind, strength) from Grenade::roll for the sound layer locally; an Event::GrenadeBounced only if online clinks matter.

gaps.title: A grenade set off by another blast looks like a spent fuse
gaps.detail: Game::blast runs nearby grenades' fuses to 0 (set_off_grenades) and they log a plain GrenadeBlast; there is no chained flag to thin the cascade as fx thins chained drums.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add chained: bool to Event::GrenadeBlast.

gaps.title: The flame stream's end has no event
gaps.detail: Fired is logged once per hold; the release (flame_held false in drive_player) and the fuel running dry mid-hold are silent state changes.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect Tank::flame_held / the FLAME flag falling in sample_world, and flame_fuel reaching 0 for the dry sputter.

gaps.title: The flame nozzle pushes a muzzle flash every 11 frames
gaps.detail: resolve_flames puts a muzzle ripple at each nozzle every flame_shimmer_every_frames; a sound keyed on fresh muzzle flashes would stutter on a stream unless it filters nozzles as fx.rs does.
gaps.suggested_fix: Never key launch sounds on Game::muzzle_flashes; if used, filter by Game::flames() nozzle positions (src/fx.rs:1294).

gaps.title: Flame contact is reported once, with no way to tell burn from heat-shield
gaps.detail: Report::Contact logs a damage-0 Hit only on the first tick of contact; a hull under a heat shield logs the same Hit. Which hulls the stream is on each frame (Game::flame_contacts) is private.
gaps.suggested_fix: A public Game::flame_contacts() accessor (slot, heat shielded) for a sizzle loop.

gaps.title: A shot sailing over a prop leaves no trace
gaps.detail: A pass-over roll on a sandbag, fence, drum, lamp or sapling only marks the shot (note_passed_over).
gaps.suggested_fix: Low priority; detect by proximity in sample_world if wanted.

gaps.title: Near misses and whizz-bys are not detected
gaps.detail: Nothing measures a shot passing close to a hull. The data is there: every shot's prev_position..position (ShotState online) against the listener seat's hull.
gaps.suggested_fix: In the sound layer's sample_world, a closest-approach test per shot id against each local seat's hull box, once per id; the LaserBeam segment for beams. Keep it client-side, off the simulation.

gaps.title: Bullets striking an aircraft or a drone without downing it
gaps.detail: The air branch of resolve_projectiles flashes and counts Drone::hits / Aircraft::hits; only the downing hit is evented.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::Hit with an Air target (or Event::AirHit { key, x, y }).

gaps.title: Shots that land on the end screen log no Hit
gaps.detail: resolve_projectiles(live false) detonates without apply_hit, and shell_vs_shell is not run there; impact sounds keyed on Hit go silent under the end banner.
gaps.suggested_fix: Key impacts on the shot's Hit0 edge (as Fx::watch_impacts does, src/fx.rs:1310), using Hit only for target and material.

gaps.title: Ram has no contact point and no impact speed
gaps.detail: Event::Ram { slot, other_slot, damage }: damage is a roll independent of how hard they hit, fx re-derives the point from contacts or the hulls' midpoint, and a replica steps no physics so it has no contacts.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add x, y and the closing speed (impact_speed, already computed in ram) to Event::Ram.

gaps.title: A press short of ammo does nothing, silently
gaps.detail: Every arm of dispatch_fire just skips when the stock cannot cover the shot (a twin chassis needs 2 shells); there is no dry-fire signal.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect the press with fire_cooldown out and no shot in the sound layer (input + state), or an Event::DryFire { slot, weapon } kept off the wire.

gaps.title: No reload, ready or low-ammo signals
gaps.detail: The magazine regains a shell every 2 s, the missile pod refills over 1.3 s, a special runs dry and falls back to shells - all silent state changes; a seat has no audible cue that it can fire again or is about to run out.
gaps.suggested_fix: State edges in sample_world on shells_ammo, fire_cooldown and active_weapon for the local seats (TankState.shells and weapon online).

gaps.title: ShieldBroken does not say why
gaps.detail: The same event follows a pool spent by a hit, the 6 s clock running out (tick_shield) and a rod's crush.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add a cause (spent/expired/crushed) to Event::ShieldBroken.

gaps.title: A shield soaking a hurt is indistinguishable from a contact report
gaps.detail: take_damage spends the pool and returns 0, so a beam, blast or ram on a shield logs Hit { damage: 0 }, the same as a stream's first-contact report.
gaps.suggested_fix: An absorbed flag on Event::Hit, or diff shield_hp per tank in the sound layer.

gaps.title: Own shots online: the room's events arrive late
gaps.detail: A client draws its own shells, bullets, plasma and laser at the press (Predictor::launch_due, net::round's fly_own_shots, local_hit); the room's Fired and Hit for that seat come a round trip later and must be skipped. Missiles, grenades and the flamethrower are not predicted (ProvisionalKind is Shell/Bullet/Plasma), so their own-press sounds can only play late.
gaps.suggested_fix: Hook own-seat launch and impact sounds on the predictor (take_muzzles, launch_due, local_hit), skip the seat's Fired as Show::OwnShotsDrawn does; play a predicted launch for missiles, grenades and the stream on the press.

gaps.title: Hit positions and amounts that do not mean what they say
gaps.detail: A blast's Hit on a hull is placed at the blast's centre, not the hull (a bong's is at the bong). A shot on a burning tile or a fused drum reports the rolled damage although damage_obstacle refused it (props.rs:263).
gaps.suggested_fix: Report the hull's position for blast hits; report the damage that landed for tiles.

gaps.title: Wrecks are silent to gunfire
gaps.detail: The sweep skips wrecks so a shot passes through a hulk with no hit; a sound can only stay silent, which may read as a bug next to the hulk.
gaps.suggested_fix: Keep as designed, or a faint cosmetic tick from a client-side proximity test.

gaps.title: Seats never ram each other with three or more on the field
gaps.detail: sync_tanks_and_ram exchanges a seat-seat ram only when exactly two seats are on the field; in a 3-8 seat room two seats crashing make no Ram event (only physics contacts, which a replica does not have).
gaps.suggested_fix: Walk every seat pair in index order (file as its own gameplay issue).

gaps.title: TellStarted never reaches a replica
gaps.detail: The hammer's and the EMP's wind-up is the main dodge cue, but TellStarted is on NOT_SENT. A replica has only TankState::tell in tenths of a second plus TankState::weapon.
gaps.suggested_fix: In sample_world, detect Tank::tell going from None to Some (apply.rs:1006 writes it) and key the cue on tell.weapon; drive the pitch from Tell::progress.

gaps.title: ChargeStarted never reaches a replica
gaps.detail: The rail's charge start and the rod's reticle appearing are NOT_SENT. A replica has TankState::charge (exact ticks) and TankState::reticle.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect Tank::charge going from None to Some on the replica; for the rod, Tank::reticle going from None to Some. For the local seat, use the predictor's own charge (net/predict.rs).

gaps.title: An EMP's reboot has no sound
gaps.detail: The power-down is the disabled watcher's (Tank::disabled rising from nothing, a replica's too, since TankState::disabled carries it); nothing hears the electrics come back.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play the reboot on Tank::disabled falling to nothing in the disabled watcher.

gaps.title: A tower's reboot has no sound
gaps.detail: A tower going offline is the disabled watcher's (Tower::disabled rising from nothing; a replica's from the tile's DISABLED flag); nothing marks one coming back.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play the reboot on Tower::disabled falling to nothing in the disabled watcher.

gaps.title: DroneLockLost is not sent
gaps.detail: A seat's 'drone on me' warning tone has to stop when the lock breaks (wreck, canopy, teleport). The event is NOT_SENT, so a replica must read DroneState::lock.
gaps.suggested_fix: Track each drone's lock by id in sample_world; when it drops to none, end the lock tone.

gaps.title: Charge stages (full, overcharged, vent warning) have no events
gaps.detail: The rail's 'ready' ping, overcharge crackle and vent warning are the moments a player times a release by. All three are only ChargeRule::stage over Charge::ticks and Charge::vent_in.
gaps.suggested_fix: Derive them in sample_world from Tank::charge.ticks() against weapon.charge_rule() (exact on the wire), or add Event::ChargeStage { slot, stage } (not sent).

gaps.title: A drone's dive commit has no event
gaps.detail: The moment a drone commits (within 64 px, or with its battery out after 6 s) is the last warning before the burst. It is only a stage change Cruise to Dive.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect DroneState::stage turning Dive by id in sample_world; or add Event::DroneDived { id, x, y, target }.

gaps.title: EMP outages start and end silently
gaps.detail: Several moments of the outage are only timers: an enemy rebooting, a seat's special coming back, a tower back online, and the map's lamp posts going out at night and back on.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect Tank::disabled, Tank::special_offline, Tower::disabled and Game::lamps_out (RoundState::lamps_out) in sample_world.

gaps.title: A missile killed by the EMP has no event at the kill
gaps.detail: Missile::kill cuts the motor mid-air; only the later MissileDud is logged. The missiles domain's flight loop has to stop at the kill, not at the landing.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect MissileState::dead going true by id; or add Event::MissileKilled { id, x, y }.

gaps.title: Knocks and skids log only the seat's Shoved; a skid stopped by a wall logs nothing
gaps.detail: combat::knock (the sonic wave, rail recoil, rod ring, well fling) logs Event::Shoved only for an owned seat hull. An enemy's knock has no event (the rod's ring has no Hit either), and a skid that ends against a wall, at speed, has no impact event. Grenades pushed by the wave are silent too.
gaps.suggested_fix: Drive the skid loop from TankState::skid and Game::skidding speed. Detect a skid ending with high skid_speed and a sudden stop as a wall thud, or add Event::Knocked { slot, speed, skid } (not sent) at combat::knock.

gaps.title: Bong stunned or pinned has no event
gaps.detail: The hammer and the rod stun a bong, and a well pins one. All three only set flags (BongState STUNNED, PULLED).
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect Bong::is_stunned and Bong::pulled per side in sample_world.

gaps.title: Bullets hitting the heli without downing it are invisible to sound
gaps.detail: strike_aircraft counts hits up to 16 silently. Only an impact flash is pushed, and AirState carries no hit count, so a replica cannot know at all.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add Event::AircraftHit { id, x, y, hits } and send it, or put the hits on AirState.

gaps.title: ObstacleDestroyed has no cause; a drum lifted or thrown looks like one destroyed
gaps.detail: The well lifting a drum and the hammer throwing one both log ObstacleDestroyed { material: Barrel } with no blast following, the same event a drum's real death logs before its Blast. Glass shattered by sound, tiles crushed by the rod and tiles pierced by the rail cannot be told apart from a shell kill either.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add a cause byte (shot, blast, crush, pierce, sonic, lifted, thrown) to ObstacleDestroyed and WireEvent (PROTOCOL_VERSION bump), or add Event::DrumLifted { well, x, y, drum }.

gaps.title: A rod cancel and a tap both log ChargeEnded Fizzled
gaps.detail: Releasing on the hull's own cell (a deliberate cancel) and releasing a too-short tap are both Fizzled. The vent is the uplink timeout.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add ChargeEnd::Cancelled (wire enum order) or read the reticle cell against the hull's cell at the end.

gaps.title: AirStrike lacks the aircraft's position, and RodImpact the ground struck
gaps.detail: The A-10's cannon report belongs at the jet while the event sits at the impact 160 px ahead, so the jet has to be looked up by id. RodImpact does not say whether it hit dry ground, water, ice or lava, which changes the whole sound; ground_struck is read but not logged.
gaps.suggested_fix: Look up Game::aircraft() by id for the cannon. Compute the rod's ground from the replica's map (water, lava, weather) at the cell, or add a ground byte to RodImpact.

gaps.title: The jet's cannon logs one AirStrike per burst, not per run
gaps.detail: Up to six bursts land on successive ticks, while the sound is one continuous BRRRT per run. A burst held for a friend logs nothing but still counts against the run.
gaps.suggested_fix: Start the BRRRT on the first bomb:false AirStrike of an id while the jet's stage is Attack, and hold it until no burst arrives for about 0.2 s or the stage changes.

gaps.title: No fall time for the rod or the bombs: no incoming whistle
gaps.detail: The rod lands as a one-frame column at the call's end, and the jet's bombs are released and land on the same tick. Neither has a moment of descent to hear.
gaps.suggested_fix: Schedule the rod's shriek ahead of ZoneState::until, which is certain. For bombs, play a short whistle from the jet's run-in (stage Attack and closing distance), or give bombs a brief drop in the simulation.

gaps.title: Countdowns tick with no per-second edge
gaps.detail: The rod's 3-2-1 and the air call's countdown exist only as an end time on the round clock (ZoneState::until, AirState::arrive). On a client they are read through zone_lead.
gaps.suggested_fix: In sample_world, beep when ceil(left) changes, reading time with Game::zone_lead so the beeps match the drawn digits.

gaps.title: Lock-on warnings are only drawn off screen
gaps.detail: A seat in a charging rail's lane, a drone locked on a seat and a rod designator painting a seat are warned of only by off-screen arrows. On screen nothing calls them out.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play a local-seat lock tone from the same predicates: TankView::lane, the DroneState::lock of drones on this seat, and an enemy reticle within a cell or two of this seat.

gaps.title: Specials run dry or come back online silently
gaps.detail: When a special's stock hits 0 the trigger falls back to shells with no signal. After the EMP's own 3 s offline nothing says the weapon is ready again.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect TankState::weapon changing from a special to Shell with ammo 0 (empty click), and TankState::offline falling to 0 (ready chime).

gaps.title: Own presses: the show events are removed, but the room's Fired arrives late
gaps.detail: A client draws its own SonicBlast, EmpPulse, RailSlug leg 0, DroneLaunched, RodCalled and orb from the press; the claimed show events are filtered out of game.events. The room's Fired for that seat is still handed on a round trip later. A sound keyed on Fired would play late, and one keyed on the show event would never play.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play own-press cues from the PressShow dispatch in net/round.rs (fly_own_shots), and skip the local seat's Fired in the event feed (Show::client_drew).

gaps.title: WellAnchored and ChargeEnded play twice for the local seat
gaps.detail: The local seat's anchor by press and its charge end are predicted and drawn at the press (round.rs:1153, round.rs:1379). The room's WellAnchored and ChargeEnded only skip their spectacle (apply.rs:531, apply.rs:555); they still reach game.events.
gaps.suggested_fix: Filter the local seat's WellAnchored { by: Press } and ChargeEnded out of the sound feed, as apply_spectacle already does for drawing.

gaps.title: A local seat's rod call shows twice: its provisional zone, then the room's
gaps.detail: A client's own call is a provisional zone (id at or above PROVISIONAL_ZONE_BASE) that the room's copy replaces. A zone-appearance detector fires twice, and the countdown is read on zone_lead.
