gaps.suggested_fix: Ignore zones with provisional() when it comes to starts; key call cues on PressShow::Rod for the own seat and on RodCalled for everyone else.

gaps.title: One-tick storms: rod impact, well collapse, rail pierce, EMP ring
gaps.detail: A rod logs RodImpact plus up to about 45 ObstacleDestroyed, drum Blasts, crushed Hits, Wrecks and ShieldBrokens in one tick. A well's held drums all go off in the collapse tick. A rail slug's pierce list can name a dozen things. An EMP ring disables a pack (Disabled plus ShieldBroken each) within 0.2 s. A sonic wave hits several hulls and panes.
gaps.suggested_fix: Aggregate per tick per source: one big cue plus a capped sprinkle; duck everything under rod_impact and well_collapse; stagger rail pierces by distance.

gaps.title: Many loops at once: drones, halos, disabled hulls, swallowed bullets
gaps.detail: Twelve drones per tank in flight, several halos humming, a pack of disabled hulls crackling, and a minigun stream into a well logging Swallowed per bullet.
gaps.suggested_fix: Cap the drone buzz to the nearest few and blend the rest into a swarm bed. Use one halo loop per tank and rate-limit Swallowed per well.

gaps.title: A swallowed drone logs three events
gaps.detail: A drone reaching a core logs DroneDowned { by: well } and Swallowed { Drone } in one tick, then DroneCrashed later because it still falls as a dud.
gaps.suggested_fix: Let Swallowed win in its tick and suppress that drone's later crash cue, or drop the fall in the simulation.

gaps.title: The well's pull starting, and grenades captured, have no events
gaps.detail: The forming-to-pulling edge (when the drone loop should swell) and a grenade caught onto the ring are only state.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect ZoneState::stage turning 1 per well id, and Grenade::orbit turning Some.

gaps.title: Hulls grinding in a well's clump: nothing draws or logs it
gaps.detail: Hulls pulled against walls or each other scrape there until the collapse (the solver's contact, no damage). The doc names it, but no event, particle or picture shows it.
gaps.suggested_fix: Read the contacts (Game::contacts) of hulls in a pull in sample_world for a grinding loop, and maybe add sparks in fx.

gaps.title: Wind-ups and charges lapse with no event on most paths
gaps.detail: A tell lapses silently on a wreck, an EMP, a teleport, the round's end or a lost weapon. A charge is cleared with no ChargeEnded on a wreck, an EMP or the round's end; only a weapon swap logs Lapsed. A sound loop cannot tell an abort from a fire without waiting a tick.
gaps.suggested_fix: End the loops on state, but play the abort cue only when no SonicBlast, EmpPulse or RailSlug from that slot arrives in the same tick. Or log ChargeEnded { Lapsed } and a TellLapsed (not sent) on every path.

gaps.title: Tiles catch fire silently
gaps.detail: A flammable plank or tree that reaches zero health turns burning with no event (Obstacle::damage, settle_chunks), and tick_fires lights wood, trees and boards beside a burning cell with no event either. Only the stream, embers, towers and the volcano's surge push Ignited, so most fires that spread across a map start silently.
gaps.suggested_fix: Push Event::Ignited { what, x, y } wherever Obstacle::burning flips true, or edge-detect tile_flags::BURNING per cell in sample_world (works on a replica).

gaps.title: Drum fuses light silently
gaps.detail: arm_fuse runs from a blast's reach and from a burning cell with no event; the code says so on purpose ('Fusing is silent: the drum's own lit column and glow are the tell'). Only the stream's Ignited{drum} reports one. The fuse hiss is the warning a player needs before a chain.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::FuseLit { x, y, drum, seconds }, or edge-detect Game::fused_barrels / tile_flags::FUSED and read Fuse::left for the pitch.

gaps.title: Chained drum cascades
gaps.detail: A drum row cascades at barrel_fuse_seconds 0.18 x 0.5-2.5 x the drum factor: links 90-450 ms apart, each logging Blast plus ObstacleDestroyed{Barrel}, five FireStarted for an oil pool, up to two delayed CookOffs, and a ChunksBroken for every chunked tile in reach. A volcano adds nine lava Blasts in five seconds, each with its pool cells.
gaps.suggested_fix: Cap blast voices (4), merge blasts within ~80 ms and 3 cells into one larger boom with a rolling tail, attenuate by distance, duck ambience; fx already halves chained sizes (fx.rs:999).

gaps.title: Fire spread and embers are per cell
gaps.detail: FireStarted is per cell (five per oil drum, six a second along a trail), EmberFlew is per burning wood or tree every 0.9 s, ChunksCharred per plank chunk, and a surge's Ignited arrives for every bank tile in one frame. Played per event, a forest fire is a wall of one-shots.
gaps.suggested_fix: Drive fire as loops from Game::burning_cells and burning_tiles (one voice per fire_groups group or per listener); one-shots only for a group's first cell and near the listener.

gaps.title: Two events for one moment
gaps.detail: obstacle_died pushes ObstacleDestroyed{Barrel} and Blast for the same drum; launch_drum pushes ObstacleDestroyed{Barrel} and DrumLaunched; a flame collapse pushes Ignited{sandbag|fence} then ObstacleDestroyed; a flame-lit ground cell pushes FireStarted and Ignited{ground|oil}; a killing shot pushes Hit{killed:true} and ObstacleDestroyed. A naive event-to-cue map doubles each.
gaps.suggested_fix: In the sound map, suppress ObstacleDestroyed{Barrel} when a Blast or DrumLaunched shares its cell this frame, and Ignited{ground|oil} when FireStarted does; or add a cause to ObstacleDestroyed.

gaps.title: ObstacleDestroyed says what, not how
gaps.detail: The event carries material and position only: not the cause (shot, ram, blast, fire, crush, rail, domino, cascade), not whether it charred out (fx infers it by checking its own burning set, fx.rs:676), not the variant (wired glass, a tower's side, a dry tree), not the blow's direction. A splinter and a charred collapse, a felled and a burnt tree sound different.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add `how: DeathCause`, `charred: bool` and `variant: i32` to Event::ObstacleDestroyed (a protocol bump).

gaps.title: CookOff has no source
gaps.detail: Event::CookOff is the same for a drum's delayed secondaries, a wreck's ammunition and a dead gun tower's; their pops should differ (drum metal and fuel, tank shells, belt-fed rounds).
gaps.where: src/simulation/mod.rs:5456; queued at props.rs:717, towers.rs:713, mod.rs:5375
gaps.suggested_fix: Carry the source in the cookoffs queue and the event (`from: Barrel|Wreck|Tower`).

gaps.title: TeslaStrike cannot tell its kinds apart
gaps.detail: chained:false covers a tank strike and an air arc at a drone; chained:true covers a chain jump and the dying coil's discharge into every hull near. The death discharge wants a far bigger sound.
gaps.suggested_fix: Replace `chained` with `kind: Strike|Chain|Air|Death`.

gaps.title: FireStarted hides lava
gaps.detail: A lava bomb's splash lights GroundFire cells with lava set, but FireStarted only carries `pool`, so it reads as an oil pool catching.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add `lava: bool` to Event::FireStarted (FireState already carries it on the wire).

gaps.title: Gun tower: one event per burst, none per bullet
gaps.detail: TowerFired is logged when a burst begins; the five bullets that follow at gun_tower_bullet_delay_seconds spawn with no event. A burst should rattle shot by shot.
gaps.suggested_fix: Sample new Bullet entities with Owner::Tower by projectile id (as fx watch_casings does for tank bullets), or log a per-bullet event.

gaps.title: Tower heading, charge and burning are not on the wire
gaps.detail: A replica never runs tower_phase and the snapshot carries towers only as tile hp and the DISABLED flag, so on a client a gun tower never turns, a tesla never charges and a tower never burns (Tower::burning is on Tower, not Obstacle, so tile_flags::BURNING stays clear). The servo, the charge whine (the tesla's warning) and a burning tower's crackle cannot be sampled online; only TeslaStrike, TowerFired and Ignited{tower} arrive.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add tower state to TileState (a charging bit, quantised heading, burning bit), or accept event-only tower sounds online.

gaps.title: Globs, ooze and slime are absent from the snapshot
gaps.detail: Nothing in net/wire.rs carries globs in flight, ooze puddles or a hull's slime_timer, so a replica cannot sample a glob's whistle, ooze on the ground or a slimed hull's fizz; only TowerFired{bio_slush}, GlobSplashed, Slimed and SlimeWashed arrive (and fx's Slimed burst reads game.slimed(), empty on a replica).
gaps.suggested_fix: Put globs (id, from, to, age) and ooze cells in the snapshot and a SLIMED bit in TankState, or start the glob's arc on the replica from TowerFired with its aim.

gaps.title: Slime and ooze end silently
gaps.detail: A coat wears off when slime_timer reaches zero, a puddle dries or a fire takes it, all with no event; only washing in water reports.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::SlimeWorn { slot } or edge-detect is_slimed per hull locally.

gaps.title: Clock-driven world edges have no events
gaps.detail: The volcano's Rumble, Erupt and Cool stages and nightfall have no events; eruption_show computes the edges but returns only a Spectacle. All are pure functions of the round clock (and the volcano shifts on the wire), so they line up online.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect Volcano::phase(time).stage per volcano and night_has_fallen in sample_world; or log Event::VolcanoStage { cell, stage }.

gaps.title: Lightning has no event, no strike time and no place
gaps.detail: weather::lightning is a brightness envelope; the strike times live inside the private strike(), and a strike has no position. Thunder needs the strike's start and a delay, ideally a distance.
gaps.suggested_fix: Expose a pure `weather::strikes(time, t)` returning strike start times (and a hashed strike point) so sample_world schedules thunder; still nothing on the wire.

gaps.title: Contacts do not say what was touched
gaps.detail: Game::contacts reports a hull's hardest contact and whether it was a tank, never what else: a scrape along brick, iron, a sandbag, a tree, the boundary, a lake shore's or deep lava's collider all read the same. The grinding sound is the target's material.
gaps.suggested_fix: Return the other collider's kind (Material, boundary, water, lava) from Physics::contact_stats.

gaps.title: Tread surface misses rubble, oil, ooze and lava
gaps.detail: Tank::tread.surface is Grass, Road, Sand, Ford, Deep or Ice; rubble (which slows the hull), oil cells, ooze puddles and a lava ford (reported as Deep) are not surfaces, and mud is implied only by the sky or wet tracks.
gaps.suggested_fix: Extend Surface (Rubble, Oil, Ooze, LavaFord) or let sample_world query Game::rubble, oil_cells, ooze and lava under each hull.

gaps.title: Water entry and dousing are state only
gaps.detail: A hull wading in or out exists only as membership of Game::wading(); a burning hull is put out by water (or by a heat shield) by zeroing burn_timer with no event.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect wading() per slot as fx does (fx.rs:1408) and TankState BURNING dropping while wet.

gaps.title: Physics-derived readers are empty on a replica
gaps.detail: wading() takes speed from the physics body, grass_disturbed() filters on body velocity and contacts() reads rapier, but a replica steps no physics: its wading speed is 0, grass never rustles under other hulls, and no scrape is reported.
gaps.suggested_fix: Use Tank::tread.speed and velocity (pressed from pose deltas on a replica too) for wading and grass; accept no scrapes online or derive them from pose and tile geometry.

gaps.title: Tiles damaged by a blast are silent
gaps.detail: Game::blast damages tiles through damage_obstacle with no Hit; only chunked materials log ChunksBroken. A pane cracking, a fence dropping to its damaged stage, iron denting or a tower losing health in a blast makes no event, and neither does the stress crack a shattering pane puts on its intact neighbour.
gaps.suggested_fix: Log Event::Hit { target: Obstacle, cause: Blast } per tile reached (like hulls and bongs), or an Event::TileDamaged { material, x, y, stage }.

gaps.title: A cage forming is only implied
gaps.detail: When concrete or wired glass gives way into its cage the frame logs ChunksBroken{collapsed:true} and no ObstacleDestroyed; that absence is the only trace. The rebar groan needs inference across events.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::Caged { material, x, y }, or a `caged` flag on ChunksBroken; TileState::cage changing from 0 is the replica's edge.

gaps.title: Bonus crates drop with no event
gaps.detail: A respawned health slot may drop a shield, a bong pack or a tower pack beside it; those spawn with dropped_at set (so their air drop plays) but no PickupRespawned.
gaps.suggested_fix: Push PickupRespawned for each bonus, or detect new Pickup entities with dropped_at in sample_world.

gaps.title: Own seat's world interactions arrive a round trip late
gaps.detail: Pickups, lanterns, portal jumps and ram collapses are the room's; the client predicts only its hull and shots (predict.rs:22), so a seat hears its own crate open, lantern click, teleport or sandbag collapse one RTT after its hull touched it.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play a provisional cue from the sandbox pose (a hull reaching a crate or a portal) and drop the room's duplicate, as OwnShotsDrawn does for shots.

gaps.title: Crates catch fire and loose contents vanish silently
gaps.detail: Pickup::burn starts and a loose pickup's clock runs out and despawns it with no event; a hurt crate's health loss is silent too.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect crate_flags BURNING/LOOSE and pickup disappearance in sample_world.

gaps.title: Moments drawn only by the picture or the fx layer
gaps.detail: A crate's landing thud happens at an age inside crate_fx::drop after PickupRespawned; flying wall pieces bounce in the fx layer's own rand; thrown rubble lands at debris_flight_seconds; fish flop on the bank in Fx's shoal; a filled rut splashes in fx. None has a simulation cause at that instant.
gaps.suggested_fix: Schedule from the causing event with the known delays, or let the sound system hang off Fx (pieces, shoal) the way it hangs off Game.

gaps.title: No ambience model; BB-102 missed the world's loops
gaps.detail: The world's background is all state: burning cells and tiles, lakes and streams, lava and its surge, the always-on grass wind, rain, a sandstorm's gusts, portals, tesla coils, lamps at night, smoulders and the battle haze, woods. BB-102's sheet had rain and wind loops only. Everything a sample_world needs is readable (and on the wire or clock-pure) except the towers and the bio slush.
gaps.where: src/fx.rs:1396-1786 (the particle layer's sample_world, the pattern to follow)
gaps.suggested_fix: An ambience sampler over the view: counts of burning cells/tiles, water and stream cells, lava cells and surge, wind_at at the listener, Look::rain, gust_at, portals, lit lamps, smouldering(), battle_haze(), trees; one bed per family, crossfaded by distance.

gaps.title: Ground fires go out silently
gaps.detail: A GroundFire leaves Game::fires and lays its scar with no event; a replica learns it when the snapshot stops listing the cell.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect cells leaving burning_cells, or Event::FireOut { x, y }.

gaps.title: Contact hurts report the start, never the end
gaps.detail: Fire, lava and slime are Report::Contact: a Hit with damage 0 on the contact's first tick (Tank::touch) and on the tick that wrecks, nothing while it goes on or when it stops. A sizzle loop needs its end.
gaps.suggested_fix: Report the contact's end, or sample it: hull box against burning_cells, heat_at(hull) over heat_hurt_from, is_slimed.

gaps.title: A roll-in through a gate starts with no event
gaps.detail: WaveStarted only queues a wave; each tank's RollIn begins outside the field when a lane frees up, with no event, and TankEntered comes only on arrival. An off-screen engine approach needs the start and the gate.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::RollingIn { slot, edge, x, y } when the RollIn is added, or detect hulls outside the field with RollIn.

gaps.title: The range board rewards nothing
gaps.detail: A board takes hits like any tile; nothing marks a hit near its centre. It exists to show what a weapon does, and accuracy has no feedback.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play a bullseye ding when a Hit on a Target lands within a few px of the board's centre (the event's x, y is enough).

gaps.title: Ice is mute
gaps.detail: Frozen water never cracks under a hull, a blast or a rod; a blast on ice is not wet, so no splash either. Ice has one voice, the skid.
gaps.suggested_fix: A creak/crack layer on blasts and heavy hulls on ice (sound only, no rule).

gaps.title: Pre-ignition heat is the room's only
gaps.detail: Obstacle::heat and Game::heat (the stream's exposure before a tile or cell catches, also the board's soot) are not on the wire, so a client cannot hear a wall heating toward ignition, only the catch.
gaps.suggested_fix: Accept it, or carry a quantised heat in TileState while a stream is on a tile.

gaps.title: EmberFlew has no source
gaps.detail: An ember from a burning tile and one a gust lifts off an ember bed (the relight rule) are the same event.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add `from: Tile|Bed` to Event::EmberFlew.

gaps.title: Hull contacts exist only as rapier state, and not at all online
gaps.detail: Wall slams, grinding, hull-on-hull pressure and shoving a wreck have no Event: fx.rs samples Game::contacts (mod.rs:6029-6050) and detects slams itself (fx.rs:851-876). A replica steps no physics, so its contacts are empty and every one of these is silent online; only Event::Ram travels.
gaps.suggested_fix: An Event::Impact { slot, x, y, impulse, other: Wall | Tile(material) | Tank(slot) | Bong(side) } on the step a contact opens (watch_slams' rule, moved into the simulation), sent; and a GRINDING bit in tank_flags for the held contact.

gaps.title: A contact does not say what was struck
gaps.detail: ContactStats knows fixed versus dynamic only (physics.rs:487-503): brick, iron, glass, a sandbag, the field's edge, deep water's collider and the bong all read as touching_static. Collider friction is uniform on purpose, and the design note says material feel should come from contact effects instead (physics.rs:147-160), which needs the material.
gaps.suggested_fix: Map the other collider back to its Obstacle (Material) or to the boundary/water/bong in contact_stats, and carry it in the impact event.

gaps.title: Event::Ram carries the damage roll, not how hard they hit
gaps.detail: damage is drawn from ram_damage_min..max whatever the closing speed (combat.rs:602); two hulls merely touching exchange a Ram every ram_damage_cooldown (0.5 s). The closing speed is computed (combat.rs:625-627) and dropped, and the event has no position.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add impact_speed (closing speed along the axis) and the contact point to Event::Ram and WireEvent::Ram (bump PROTOCOL_VERSION).

gaps.title: Seats ram each other only when there are exactly two
gaps.detail: sync_tanks_and_ram matches `[(p1, _), (p2, _)]` (mod.rs:5030), so a room of three or more seats bumps with no Ram, no damage and no sound.
gaps.suggested_fix: Walk seat pairs i<j as ram_enemy_pairs does (keeping the two-seat stream pinned).

gaps.title: Every locomotion moment is a state edge
gaps.detail: Pulling away, letting go into a brake slide, a pivot or a reversal, a slide across the runs, a track spin on ice and wading in or out of a ford are all only in drive_tank_with (mod.rs:6681-6809) and Tank::tread (simulation/wear.rs:201-245). Tread already holds speeding_up and roll but no braking flag; nothing marks water entry.
gaps.suggested_fix: Detect per slot in sample_world from Game::driving (works on a replica, which presses its own treads); add Tread::braking and a surface-changed edge.

gaps.title: Enemy throttle is not on the wire; the own seat's hull is predicted
gaps.detail: TankState carries the body velocity in 4 px/s steps and the facing (wire.rs:41, 522-527), not the commanded intent or throttle, so an enemy's engine can only follow its motion, never lead it. The client predicts its own hull, so its engine and treads must follow the predicted pose; a refused pose snaps it (Event::Placed, mod.rs:489) and would pop a loop.
gaps.suggested_fix: Drive loops from the drawn pose (pose.rs Smooth) with smoothing; optionally a 2-bit throttle code in TankState::flags.

gaps.title: The tread's surface has no rubble
gaps.detail: wear::Surface is Grass/Road/Sand/Ford/Deep/Ice (simulation/wear.rs:30-43); Footing::on_rubble slows a hull over light or heavy rubble (mod.rs:6385-6396) but neither Tread nor Driving reports it.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add the cell's RubbleLevel to Driving (Game::rubble is crate-visible and on the wire, net/apply.rs:332-339).

gaps.title: Damage tier crossings have no event
gaps.detail: A hull crossing 25/50/75 damage changes its art, starts smoking at 50 and burning at 75 (tank.rs:1552, damage_stage.rs:29-33) with no event.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect damage_tier per slot in sample_world from hp (on the wire as TankState::hp).

gaps.title: No low-health warning for a seat
gaps.detail: The only signal that a seat is about to die is its HP number turning red under hud_critical_threshold (hud.rs:584-593).
gaps.suggested_fix: A seat-only warning loop keyed on health_fraction, per couch seat.

gaps.title: Event::Wreck has no cause, killer or variant
gaps.detail: Wreck { slot, x, y } (mod.rs:616) says nothing of what wrecked it (Tank::wrecked_by, combat.rs:203-205) or whether the fireball is a mushroom (hashed in BlastFx::wreck, blast.rs:179). The chassis can be looked up by slot while the wreck stands (TankState::row on the wire).
gaps.suggested_fix: Add by: Option<Owner>, cause: HitCause and mushroom: bool (mirror on the wire).

gaps.title: Shield events cannot tell absorb, spend, time-out or crush apart
gaps.detail: A shield taking a blast, flame, ram or bite yields an Event::Hit with damage 0, the same as a zero roll (tank.rs:1460-1464, combat.rs:191-213). ShieldBroken (mod.rs:649) comes from the pool spent (tank.rs:1437-1443), the clock running out (tank.rs:2206-2213) or a rod (tank.rs:2292-2298) alike.
gaps.suggested_fix: absorbed: bool on Event::Hit; why: Spent | Expired | Crushed on ShieldBroken.

gaps.title: Lasting conditions end silently, and the ooze coat is not on the wire
gaps.detail: A speed boost, heat shield, afterburn and slime coat all run out on timers (mod.rs:2641-2644, tank.rs:1031) with no event, and water ends a boost at once (mod.rs:6696). A lasting contact (flame, lava, fire, ooze) reports Event::Hit only on its first tick and the wrecking tick (combat.rs:214-217); Tank::contacts (tank.rs:995-1000) has the rest but is not on the wire. TankState flags have BOOST, BURNING and HEAT_SHIELD but no SLIMED (wire.rs:486-504) and net/apply.rs never sets slime_timer, so a replica can start an ooze loop on Event::Slimed and never stop it (and fx.rs:1551's drips never show online).
gaps.suggested_fix: Add tank_flags::SLIMED; let sample_world edge-detect the flags and Tank::contacts (add CONTACT bits for lava/fire/ooze to the wire if loops must end online).

gaps.title: The reboot after an EMP has no event
gaps.detail: The power-down is heard from Tank::disabled rising (the disabled watcher, on a replica too); the reboot, Tank::disabled reaching nothing, is heard by nothing.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect Tank::disabled reaching nothing in the disabled watcher.

gaps.title: A roll-in starts without an event
gaps.detail: A wave tank, a returning seat and a re-rolled straggler start driving in from outside the field silently (spawn_wave_tank waves.rs:774, seat_returns waves.rs:547, reroll waves.rs:434); only the arrival has TankEntered. The approach from off-screen is exactly what a sound should announce.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::RollInStarted { slot, x, y } (sent), or detect a new tank with a RollIn / a new TankState id outside the field.

gaps.title: A wrecked seat waits with no cue
gaps.detail: WaveState::returning and wrecked_for (waves.rs:104-117) are private and not on the wire; nothing tells the player they are queued for the next wave, or when.
gaps.suggested_fix: A Game accessor for the return queue (and its place in RoundState); a 'you are back with the next wave' cue.

gaps.title: Bong hops and landings have no event or reason
gaps.detail: start_hop (bong.rs:499) is called for an evasive hop, a rod's circle, a pack, a blast and the training walk (mod.rs:3415-3446, training.rs:455-481) with nothing recorded; the landing (bong.rs:538-545) neither, nor whether it landed in water. bong_flags::HOPPING (wire.rs:702) is enough for the edge.
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect HOPPING in sample_world; if the reason matters, Event::BongHop { side, reason, to }.

gaps.title: BongBite has no position
gaps.detail: BongBite { side, slot, damage, killed } (mod.rs:653): the bong's position and kind must be looked up by side and the victim's by slot.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add the bong's x, y (as BongHealed has).

gaps.title: The bong has a voice only in training, and only as text
gaps.detail: BongVoice runs only on a training map (bubble.rs:67-71); in every other round the bong never says anything, though it is hurt, bites, heals and dies. Nothing maps the seven kinds' strikes and knock-outs (BONG_SPEC.md:7-15) to a voice.
gaps.suggested_fix: A per-BongKind voice set for hurt, bite, hop, heal and knock-out in every round, plus per-word babble for the training bubble.

gaps.title: The AI's audible moments are trace-only and never travel
gaps.detail: Alert, Retreat, Breach, StuckEscape, Retarget and AiAction are recorded only while Game::trace_ai is set (mod.rs:788-791, 4084, 4145, 7348-7361) and are on NOT_SENT (net/events.rs:45-51), as is StragglersCalled (net/events.rs:44). A sound system off the default feed hears none of them; a replica never can.
gaps.suggested_fix: A small always-on, rate-limited bark event (Event::Bark { slot, kind }) that is sent, separate from the trace.

gaps.title: An enemy spotting a seat or waking has no event at all
gaps.detail: Ai::in_sight rising (ai.rs:1535-1537) and a field-map tank waking (FieldMind::awake, field.rs:97-99) are not recorded even under trace_ai.
gaps.suggested_fix: Diff in_sight and awake in the enemy phase's snapshot comparison (ai_transition_events) and feed the bark event.

gaps.title: C2 radio chatter has nothing to hang on
gaps.detail: c2_enabled is false by default (tuning.rs:2533); Signal has no producer (comms.rs:105); only the reflex orders Slow/Hold/Nudge are issued (comms.rs:127-156) and none is logged as an event.
gaps.suggested_fix: When C2 is on, an Event::Order { slot, order } for the producers' orders; until then, chatter keyed on the bark event.

gaps.title: Round beats that are only state edges
gaps.detail: Play starting when the mission banner ends or is skipped (intro_timer reaching 0, mod.rs:2693-2697) and a wave being cleared (the breather starting, waves.rs:292-298) have no event; cleared and timed out look the same.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::PlayStarted and Event::WaveCleared { wave, timed_out }, sent (or edge-detect intro_timer and wave_banner()).

gaps.title: Music intensity exists only on field maps, locally
gaps.detail: The director's intensity (director.rs:138-200) runs only on field maps with director_enabled; arenas and band rounds have no measure, and a replica gets only next_wave.
gaps.suggested_fix: A presentation-side intensity from the director's inputs (losses, enemies in the sight box) on every map, readable on a replica.

gaps.title: The last enemy left is not marked
gaps.detail: Nothing signals that a single enemy remains with nothing more to come (live_enemy_count, waves.rs:181; spawn_plan_finished, mod.rs:5629).
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect in sample_world (works on a replica), or an Event::LastEnemy.

gaps.title: RoundEnded does not say why
gaps.detail: RoundEnded { outcome } (mod.rs:482): a loss to the seats falling and to the bong dying (mod.rs:5605-5613), and a training finish, look the same.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add a reason: SeatsDown | BongDown | EnemiesDown | EnemyBongDown | Trained.

gaps.title: The audio clock must follow the session, not the round
gaps.detail: The round steps a fixed dt, but the local end's hitstop and slow motion (Session::time_scale, mode.rs:744-764), a dialog freezing the round (Session::playing, mode.rs:772), the pause (mod.rs:2325-2341) and the dev server's lockstep all change what a player hears. A sound system reading only game time would play straight through them.
gaps.suggested_fix: Feed the sound system the session's time scale and playing flag every frame (pitch and duck by time_scale, pause loops while not playing).

gaps.title: Kill credit and friendly-fire tallies are not on the wire
gaps.detail: credit_wreck (mod.rs:5503-5516) runs only where explosions run, and nothing in src/net names RoundStats, by_seat or friendly_fire, so a replica's end screen counts nothing; the Wreck event lacks the killer too.
gaps.suggested_fix: Send RoundStats with RoundEnded, and the killer with Wreck.

gaps.title: Level unlocks are session state with no edge
gaps.detail: Campaign::won is called every frame after a counted win (mode.rs:408-427); take_progress (mode.rs:459) is the one once-per-change hook, and the level select's tile states are read fresh each frame.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play the unlock sting off take_progress returning Some (and complete going true).

gaps.title: Scripted training moments have no event
gaps.detail: A beat beginning (begin_beat, training.rs:385-397) and its air-dropped crates have no event (the first beat has no BeatDone before it), and shoot_bong spawns its shell with no Event::Fired (training.rs:423-441), so no muzzle or incoming cue.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::BeatStarted { beat } and an Event::Fired (or a dedicated scripted-shot event) from shoot_bong.

gaps.title: Many hulls, chained kills and a split screen
gaps.detail: Up to 8 seats and wave_max_alive enemies each run an engine and a tread loop; pile-ups ram in O(n^2) pairs (mod.rs:5057-5090); a multi-kill or a barrel chain pushes many Wreck and CookOff events in one frame (explosions, mod.rs:5475-5497; cookoff_count per wreck, mod.rs:5368-5376). Field maps run to 250 cells a side, and the couch's split screen (follow.rs:618-690, render/game.rs:548) shows two places at once.
gaps.suggested_fix: Voice caps per cue class with nearest-first stealing, on-screen and distance culling (fx's sees rule), aggregation of same-frame explosions, and one listener per split half mixed to the same output.

gaps.title: The own seat's Fired still reaches the replica's events
gaps.detail: Online the own shot is drawn at the press (net/round.rs:1305-1307, 1349-1415). apply_events drops only the press shows the client drew (beam, wave, ring, slug - own_presses) from game.events (apply.rs:783-789); the own Fired is kept and only its muzzle ripple and kick are skipped (apply.rs:581-586). It arrives one round trip plus the interpolation delay late (round.rs test 2487-2501, per the online scout). A sound on Event::Fired would play late, or twice if it also follows the press. The camera kick (follow.rs:1079) reads the same late Fired.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play own fire from Predictor::take_muzzles/take_press_shows and skip Fired where slot == client seat under Show::OwnShotsDrawn; or expose the claimed Fired indices (presses_drawn) to presentation consumers.

gaps.title: Own impacts are predicted, Hit events are late
gaps.detail: A provisional stops at what it meets and plays its impact at once (round.rs:1315-1344, 1416-1418); the room's Event::Hit with its material, damage and kill comes ~RTT later. An impact sound on Hit lags the picture; one on the prediction lacks the material.
gaps.suggested_fix: Play the body of the impact from watch_impacts/draw_impact and the material/kill layer from the late Hit, de-duplicated by projectile id; carry the contact's tile material in the provisional's stop.

gaps.title: A refused press sounds anyway
gaps.detail: The predictor gates presses as the server would (predict.rs:26-32) but a press the room refuses is only known after refusal_after (predict.rs:63-64, round.rs:951-958); its predicted muzzle has already been drawn, and heard.
gaps.suggested_fix: Accept it (rare), or keep the predicted fire cue short so a refusal is not jarring.

gaps.title: A frame can carry several snapshots' events
gaps.detail: A frame that steps over snapshots (after a hitch, a stall, a refocused tab) hands every passed snapshot's events over at once (interp.rs:1024-1059, hand_over 1336-1344); cosmetic ones more than EVENT_STALE_MS (250 ms) late are dropped but carries_state ones survive (RoundStarted/Ended, ObstacleDestroyed, drum and lava launches, own Fired, ...). One frame can hold dozens of explosions or tile deaths.
gaps.suggested_fix: Dedupe on game.frame() like fx (fx.rs:905); per-frame voice caps per cue; never play a carries_state event's sound when it arrived stale (compare its tick to render time).

gaps.title: No slams or scrapes on a replica
gaps.detail: watch_slams and the contact scrapes read Game::contacts(), rapier's impulses; a replica steps no physics (fx.rs:1028-1029), so online no hull ever slams or grinds against a wall - only tank-on-tank Event::Ram shows. Collision sounds would be offline-only.
gaps.suggested_fix: A wire-carried contact summary per hull (strongest impulse this tick) or an Event::Slammed { slot, x, y, strength, on_tank, material } from the physics phase.

gaps.title: Casings and debris have no simulation cause and no landing callback
gaps.detail: A case is thrown per bullet id first seen at the muzzle (fx.rs:1345-1382), thinned by fx_density with rand::rng (fx.rs:1377) and skipped off view (fx.rs:1368); its bounces live in Casings::tick (casings.rs:121-130) and chip particles bounce in Fx::tick (fx.rs:2059-2067), neither reporting anything. A sound can only follow fx, and fx density differs by platform (web lowers it).
gaps.suggested_fix: Have Casings::tick (and Pieces::tick) return the landings and bounces this tick; key the sound on the un-thinned bullet count, not on the cases drawn.

gaps.title: Wall pieces keep no material
gaps.detail: A Piece holds its atlas rect and tint but not its Material (pieces.rs:29-45); a landing clatter cannot choose brick, concrete or plank without decoding the atlas row. Landings are not reported either (pieces.rs:198-207).
gaps.suggested_fix: Store the Material on Piece and return landed pieces from Pieces::tick.

gaps.title: Muzzle flashes carry no weapon or shooter
gaps.detail: Game::muzzle_flashes are Shockwaves with a centre only; fx even looks up the nearest shot to infer the heading (fx.rs:1281-1303). It is the one fire signal that is right online for every seat, but a sound cannot tell a shell from plasma from a tower's burst.
gaps.suggested_fix: Carry slot and weapon on the muzzle flash, or pair flashes with Fired/the predictor's muzzles by position.

gaps.title: Pause and dialog freezes are state flips
gaps.detail: P flips Game::paused inside update (simulation/mod.rs:2325-2327); dialogs, the level select and questions freeze the round by not calling update (mode.rs:772-774). fx stops through fx_runs (app.rs:2548). A sound layer must detect both edges itself to pause loops and duck the bed.
gaps.suggested_fix: Reuse fx_runs(mode, playing, paused) as the mixer's 'world audible' switch, edge-detected in app.rs.

gaps.title: No event when the round goes live
gaps.detail: The round opens frozen behind the mission banner; intro_timer reaching 0 - by time or because a seat moved or fired - has no event (simulation/mod.rs:2345-2350, 2693-2701). The establishing shot's phases are app-side only (app.rs:2669-2701).
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect intro_timer > 0 -> 0 (it is on the wire), or add Event::RoundLive.

gaps.title: RoundEnded has no reason
gaps.detail: Event::RoundEnded carries Won/Lost only (simulation/mod.rs:5640-5651). Whether the bong died or every seat was wrecked, and the friendly-fire losses the end screen names (hud.rs:1467-1476), must be re-derived; the screen itself shows only YOU LOSE.
gaps.suggested_fix: Outcome reason on the event (BongDied, SeatsWrecked, Cleared, BongHunted, TrainingDone).

gaps.title: Low health, low ammo, empty gun: colour only, no dry fire
gaps.detail: Health and ammo turn orange/red at the thresholds (hud.rs:156, 584-593); at 0 the symbol dims (render/hud.rs:258); a special that runs out silently becomes shells (hud.rs:105-108, 149-168); a trigger pull on an empty gun, or a lantern press with none left, logs nothing.
gaps.suggested_fix: Event::DryFire { slot } and Event::SpecialSpent { slot, weapon } from the weapons phase; threshold edges in the HUD model.

gaps.title: Buffs run out without warning
gaps.detail: Speed-up, shield and heat-shield gauges drain to empty; nothing warns before, no event marks the end (hud.rs:375-388).
gaps.suggested_fix: A 'expiring' edge a couple of seconds before 0 and an Event::BuffEnded { slot, kind }.

gaps.title: Last enemy and a bong in danger are unmarked
gaps.detail: The enemies-left count just reads 1 (hud.rs:533-541); StragglersCalled fires only after a lull and is not sent (events.rs:44); the bong's gauge has no low cue (hud.rs:544-547).
gaps.suggested_fix: HUD-side edges (enemies left == 1, bong under a threshold) feeding stingers.

gaps.title: A crate respawning off-screen is signalled nowhere
gaps.detail: Event::PickupRespawned is sent but fx ignores it, no ArrowKind exists for pickups (indicators.rs:458-493) and the minimap shows none (minimap.rs:614-644).
gaps.suggested_fix: A pickup arrow and a spawn sparkle, plus a supply-drop cue.

gaps.title: Seat joins and leaves are roster diffs
gaps.detail: Joining, leaving, readying, going AWAY, returning and the host moving arrive only as a whole Lobby::Roster (wire.rs:1189-1199, client.rs:595-599), which round.rs:721 ignores; mid-round a teammate dropping shows nothing at all (round.rs:628-662).
gaps.suggested_fix: Diff the roster in OnlineRound::poll into ClientEvent::SeatJoined/Left/Ready/Away/Back/HostMoved.

gaps.title: The connection lifecycle is client state only
gaps.detail: Connecting, Greeting, welcomed, refused (Refusal codes, wire.rs:1314-1359), timed out (client.rs:45, 59) and closed (client.rs:368-388) are Phase transitions and ClientEvents, never Events; a mid-round close leaves the window Online on a frozen field under an OFFLINE line (round.rs:655). A close also overwrites a Kicked note (round.rs:707-709).
gaps.suggested_fix: Expose Phase edges and ClientEvents from OnlineRound to the presentation layer; stop every world loop on Closed.

gaps.title: No countdown before a room's round
gaps.detail: The host's START leads straight to the Welcome and the round (mode.rs:1164-1167); a room's round has no banner hold and no establishing shot (establish.rs:9-11).
gaps.suggested_fix: A 3-2-1 on Lobby::Started, or send the intro banner hold to rooms too.

gaps.title: The replica's opening RoundStarted is probably overwritten
gaps.detail: The welcome writes the baseline's events into game.events (apply.rs:213, 783) and the interpolator marks the baseline as handed over (interp.rs:754-758); the same frame's draw then applies a sampled snapshot that replaces game.events (round.rs:378-387, 945). Inferred from the code by the online scout, not run.
gaps.suggested_fix: Verify with the rig; hook the round-start sting on Phase::Playing / the Welcome rather than RoundStarted.

gaps.title: Back to the lobby cuts the round's last moments
gaps.detail: Lobby::Ended switches the window to the lobby on the frame it is polled (round.rs:710-715, mode.rs:1186-1197); the last interpolation delay's snapshots are never drawn, so their sounds and the tails of the end sting are cut.
gaps.suggested_fix: Let render time reach the end tick before switching, or let the mixer finish tails across the switch.

gaps.title: HUD-facing events that never reach a replica
gaps.detail: ChargeStarted, Disabled, TowerDisabled, TellStarted, AirSalvo and DroneLockLost are NOT_SENT (events.rs:52-57). The gauss charge's start, the EMP offline static, the enemy wind-up warning and the air-support ammo tick must be edge-detected online on TankState::charge/disabled/special_offline/tell and the aircraft's state, which tick_presentation runs down between snapshots (simulation/mod.rs:3286-3305).
gaps.suggested_fix: Edge-detect the state in a sample_world-style pass that runs both locally and on the replica, so one code path serves both.

gaps.title: MissileLocked is a 21st never-sent event missing from NOT_SENT
gaps.detail: from_event returns None for MissileLocked (events.rs:600) but NOT_SENT lists 20 tags without it (events.rs:37-58), and the coverage test's sample holds 85 of the 87 variants, omitting MissileLocked and MissileBlast (events.rs:824-948), so the test cannot catch it. A lock-on tone keyed on MissileLocked would silently never play online.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add missile_locked to NOT_SENT (21) and both variants to every_event; online, read the lock from the missile's state.

gaps.title: Kill hold and end slow-mo are offline only
gaps.detail: The kill hitstop runs only with hold true (app.rs:2511), which the online path never passes (app.rs:2774); Session::time_scale reads the local game's curtain (mode.rs:748-764), so a room's decisive blow has no hold or slow motion. A kill-confirm sound tied to the hold would vanish online.
gaps.suggested_fix: Hook kill-confirm on the RoundStats::by_seat increment (works on both); decide whether rooms get a sound-only accent in place of the hold.

gaps.title: The web page's audio unlock hook is dead
gaps.detail: runtime.ts resumes Module.audioContext on the first click with {once: true} (runtime.ts:58-69). Nothing sets Module.audioContext (the field is reserved, runtime.ts:26-27; raylib's miniaudio would create its own context), a click on the loading panel before any context exists spends the listener, and a player who starts with the keyboard or a touch that is not a click never unlocks. docs/platforms.md:321 also notes InitAudioDevice needs -sASYNCIFY back.
gaps.suggested_fix: Resume the real context (miniaudio's) on pointerdown, keydown and touchend, repeatedly until state is 'running'.

gaps.title: Android keeps playing in the background
gaps.detail: On APP_CMD_LOST_FOCUS raylib sets appEnabled false and blocks the loop in ALooper_pollOnce(-1) inside its event poll, with PauseMusicStream commented out (../raylib/src/platforms/rcore_android.c:792-793, 1139-1144). app.rs never gets another frame to stop sounds, so the audio device would keep playing the last loops while the app is in the background. No lifecycle handling exists in src/app/android.rs.
gaps.suggested_fix: Extend tools/android's raylib patch to stop/start the miniaudio device on lost/gained focus (or set FLAG_WINDOW_ALWAYS_RUN and pause audio from app.rs on FLAG_WINDOW_UNFOCUSED).

gaps.title: iOS has no audio backend and no lifecycle handling
gaps.detail: raylib is built with -DMA_NO_COREAUDIO (docs/platforms.md:353-354), so miniaudio has no backend on iOS until raudio.c is compiled as Objective-C; app-lifecycle events are not handled (docs/platforms.md:417-418), so there is no pause on background and no AVAudioSession interruption handling (a call, Siri, another app's audio) or silent-switch category choice.
gaps.suggested_fix: Compile raudio as ObjC, set an AVAudioSession category (ambient respects the silent switch), and handle SDL_EVENT_WILL_ENTER_BACKGROUND / interruptions.

gaps.title: A hidden web tab freezes the game but not WebAudio
gaps.detail: With fps 0 the loop runs on requestAnimationFrame (docs/platforms.md:186-189), which stops in a hidden tab, while WebAudio's callback keeps pulling the last mix; no visibilitychange handler exists in site/src/scripts. Looping engines would drone on; online, on return, the backlog's cosmetics are dropped (interp.rs:278-285) but loop state jumps.
gaps.suggested_fix: Suspend the AudioContext on visibilitychange hidden and resume on visible, telling the game through a window.bb* global + bbChanged.

gaps.title: One audio output for a couch split
gaps.detail: Two seats on one screen share a view until apart, then split along their bisector (follow.rs:18-36); feedback already scopes hurts per half (feedback.rs:33-56). One listener cannot sit in both halves, and both seats' head-locked cues (self_hit, low health, dry fire) mix together.
gaps.suggested_fix: Listener at the shared view's centre (the pair's midpoint) while together and at the midpoint of the two halves when split; pan each seat's own cues toward its side of the divider.

gaps.title: Refusals in the menus and the builder are silent
gaps.detail: Undo/redo on an empty stack (editor/mod.rs:1775), copy/cut/delete/flip with nothing selected (mod.rs:2444, 2465, 2482), paste with an empty clipboard (mod.rs:2512), steppers and resize at their limits (mod.rs:4768-4775, 1885), a stale FIX (mod.rs:2352-2360), PLAY HERE falling back to PLAY (mode.rs:961), a locked level tile (level_select.rs:235), a disabled lobby button or a sixth code character (lobby.rs:396-404, 509-515). The builder's one status line shows success and error alike and never clears.
gaps.suggested_fix: Return an Ok/Refused/Error result from each UI action so one 'refused' cue can follow every one.

gaps.title: Builder strokes change many cells per frame
gaps.detail: A fast PEN drag walks an edge-joined line, so several cells change in one frame (editor/mod.rs:891, 2092); FILL lays hundreds at once (mod.rs:2283); SCATTER lays a footprint per cell crossed.
gaps.suggested_fix: One tick per frame scaled by the cells changed, rate-limited.

gaps.title: The bong's voice is text only and training only
gaps.detail: BongVoice queues message keys from beats and a few events (bubble.rs:59-148); a line appearing and its words revealing (bubble.rs:337-340) report nothing. Outside training the bong never speaks, though it bites, hops and falls.
gaps.suggested_fix: Expose the line-shown and word-revealed edges from BongVoice; consider a few voice barks outside training (bitten, healed, low).

gaps.title: The wave breather has no countdown and WaveStarted no 'final' flag
gaps.detail: waves.rs keeps next_in (waves.rs:138) but nothing shows or ticks it; the banner just vanishes when the wave is called. WaveStarted { wave, size, tier } does not say it is the last wave; the HUD reads wave_status (waves.rs:143-152).
gaps.suggested_fix: Tick the last seconds of next_in; add final: bool to WaveStarted (wire bump).

gaps.title: No single clock for audio
gaps.detail: The round's picture runs on scaled time (time_scale holds and slow-mo, app.rs:2490), the particles on fx_dt (0 while frozen, simulated time under a dev-server lockstep, app.rs:2481-2550), the kill hold on real time (feedback.rs:279-290), the bubble on voice_dt (app.rs:2856), the replica on raw_dt. Each sound class needs one of these chosen explicitly, or sounds will run on through a hold, a pause or a lockstep freeze.
gaps.suggested_fix: Give the sound layer the same (fx_dt, real dt, time_scale) triple fx and feedback get, and classify each cue as world-time or real-time.

rules.name: listener_jump
rules.text: The listener moves with the view; spatial voices crossfade rather than jump.

rules.name: split_listener
rules.text: Where the one listener sits when the couch splits the screen in two.

rules.name: net_stall
rules.text: When snapshots stop arriving, loops hold their last state, then fade.

rules.name: replica_feed
rules.text: Online, every world sound plays from the replica's events, which are the room's.

rules.name: fire_by_flash
rules.text: An alternative fire hook, the muzzle flash, which is already right online.

rules.name: own_fire_predicted
rules.text: Online, the own seat's fire sounds play at the press, and its Fired from the room is skipped.

rules.name: own_impact_predicted
rules.text: Online, the own seat's impacts play where the predicted picture stops the shot.

rules.name: shot_impact_generic
rules.text: Impacts keyed on what the picture shows (the impact frames), not on Event::Hit.

rules.name: self_hit_direction
rules.text: The self-hit sting is panned toward where the blow came from.

rules.name: spectate_muffle
rules.text: A wrecked seat's own layers stop, and the world muffles slightly while it waits.

rules.name: mix_time_stretch
rules.text: The mix ducks and pitches down with the round-end slow motion and the kill hold.

rules.name: music_intensity
rules.text: Drives the music's layers up and down with the fight.

events.name: Fired
events.doc: A trigger pull that launched something. A twin barrel's queued second shot and a burst's later bullets are part of the same pull.
events.fx_elsewhere: muzzle flash from Game::muzzle_flashes (state) via muzzle_sparks fx.rs:1287; replica ripple apply.rs:581-586; camera kick follow.rs:1079; lane flash indicators.rs:945

events.name: Placed
events.doc: The room moved a client-owned hull itself - a refused pose, a portal, a gate - and the client snaps to it (docs/online-coop-prd.md §4.14).
events.no_sound: A network correction: the room snaps a client's own hull. It should never be heard.

events.name: LaserBeam
events.doc: A laser beam was drawn from the laser module's lens at (`x0`, `y0`) to where the gun line stopped it at (`x1`, `y1`): an instant hit leaves nothing in the world for a snapshot to carry, so the beam itself is the event a replica draws it from (`LaserVariant::name`). A beam bent by portals is one event a leg (docs/teleporting.md, "Shots"): `leg` 0 leaves the lens, a later one the portal the last came out of, and `portal` says the leg ends going into a portal rather than where the beam stopped.
events.fx: [(portal false)] Laser impact + spark cone back toward the gun (fx.rs:1261-1271)

events.name: Shoved
events.doc: A velocity change the room put on a client-owned hull (knockback, a blast, a ram, a missile launch's recoil, a sonic hammer's knock); the owner applies it to its own body, since the room places that hull wherever the owner says (docs/online-coop-prd.md §4.16). `skid` is the seconds a knock takes the hull off its tracks (`Tank::skid`, docs/sonic-hammer.md), 0 for every other shove.

events.name: Hit
events.doc: A projectile, beam or wave landed on `target` at (`x`, `y`); `cause` says which kind of thing it was, for what draws it.
events.fx: [(cause Blast|Lava|Fire|Slime)] nothing (the world's own events draw it) (fx.rs:950); [(cause Rail|Rod)] flash only on tank or tile (fx.rs:955-960); [(cause Spall)] tank flash + masonry cone toward the hull (fx.rs:964-979); tile flash + tile_chip by material (Dust impact, glass, iron sparks, wood, sand, leaves, stone) (fx.rs:983-987, 731-766); [(cause Sonic on a tank)] flash + dust and grit, no sparks (fx.rs:1166-1175); [(Bong)] bong flash + flecks of its BongKind body + dust (fx.rs:1179-1182, 446-453); [(Player|Enemy)] flash + sparks, armour chips, smoke wisp (fx.rs:1186-1196); [(Wall = field edge)] sparks + dust (fx.rs:1197-1201)

events.name: SonicBlast
events.doc: A sonic hammer fired by `slot` from the pivot (`x`, `y`) along `dir` (`Dir::name`) (docs/sonic-hammer.md): the wave a replica draws. Logged right after its `Fired`, in the same tick.
events.fx_elsewhere: sonic_show (sonic.rs:268); replica apply.rs:514-518; fish thrown fish.rs:478

events.name: TellStarted
events.doc: An enemy in owner slot `slot` began the wind-up of `weapon` (`ActiveWeapon::name`, `tank::Tell`). Not sent: the tell's state travels in `TankState::tell`.
events.fx_elsewhere: tank tell render, wind-up arrow in indicators (not sent)

events.name: EmpPulse
events.doc: An EMP fired by `slot` from the pivot (`x`, `y`) (docs/emp-burst.md): the ring a replica draws. Logged right after its `Fired`, in the same tick.

events.name: Disabled
events.doc: The tank in owner slot `slot`, at (`x`, `y`), was disabled by an EMP's ring (`Tank::disable`). Not sent: `TankState::disabled` is what draws, and what the sound's `disabled` watcher hears go out (`audio::watch`), on a replica as in a local round.
events.fx_elsewhere: TankState::disabled render; HUD WPN OFFLINE (not sent)

events.name: TowerDisabled
events.doc: The tower at (`x`, `y`) went offline under an EMP's ring (`Tower::disable`). Not sent: the tile's `DISABLED` flag is what draws, and what the `disabled` watcher hears go out.

events.name: MissileDud
events.doc: A missile an EMP killed came down at (`x`, `y`) a dud: no blast.

events.name: RailSlug
events.doc: One leg of a gauss rail's slug fired by `slot` (docs/gauss-rail.md): drawn from (`x0`, `y0`) to where it stopped or went into a portal (`portal`), `leg` 0 first, and every thing it went through, in order, where it went in. `seat` is `net::wire::NO_SEAT` for an enemy's. Leg 0 is logged right after its `Fired`, in the same tick.
events.fx: bore spark cone (leg 0) + end splash unless into a portal (fx.rs:1244-1257)

events.name: ChargeStarted
events.doc: The tank in owner slot `slot` started a charge of `weapon` (`ActiveWeapon::name`, `Tank::charge`). Not sent: the charge's state travels in `TankState::charge`.

events.name: ChargeEnded
events.doc: The charge of `weapon` on the tank in owner slot `slot` ended without firing: let go early, held past its vent, or lost.

events.name: DroneLaunched
events.doc: A drone `id` left the halo of the tank in owner slot `slot` from its slot's ground point (`x`, `y`) (docs/fpv-swarm.md), locked on the tank in owner slot `target`, on the players' bong (`bong`), or on nothing. Logged after its `Fired`, in the same tick.

events.name: DroneBurst
events.doc: The drone `id`, launched by `slot`, burst at (`x`, `y`) - `crown` in a tree's leaves.
events.fx: Charge explosion, leaves when in a crown (fx.rs:1101-1107)

events.name: DroneDowned
events.doc: The drone `id` was struck in the air over (`x`, `y`), `height` px up, by `by` (`air::AirStrike::name`), and falls.

events.name: DroneCrashed
events.doc: A downed drone `id` reached the ground at (`x`, `y`): a dud.

events.name: DroneLockLost
events.doc: The drone `id` lost its lock (`why`: "wreck", "gone", "canopy", "teleport") and dives where its target last was. Not sent: the drone's `lock` is the state.

events.name: AirSupportCalled
events.doc: Seat `seat` called air support (docs/air-support.md): call `id`, a `sortie`, arriving at round time `arrive` - `None` while it waits behind the seat's sortie before it.

events.name: AirSupportArrived
events.doc: Call `id`'s aircraft came in at (`x`, `y`), outside the field; `armed` false when it found no enemy to attack.

events.name: AirSalvo
events.doc: The helicopter `id` fired a salvo at (`x`, `y`): its rockets are the missiles, and this is the launch a client hears.

events.name: AirStrike
events.doc: One of the jet `id`'s cannon bursts, or (`bomb`) one of its bombs, landed at (`x`, `y`).
events.fx: bomb: Charge explosion; cannon: sparks, dust, splash (fx.rs:1004-1009)

events.name: AircraftDowned
events.doc: The helicopter `id` was struck down over (`x`, `y`), `height` px up, by `by` (`air::AirStrike::name`).
events.fx: sparks in the air + Hull explosion below (fx.rs:1012-1015)

events.name: AirSupportLeft
events.doc: Air support `id` is done: its aircraft left the field, or its seat was gone when it came.

events.name: RodCalled
events.doc: The tank in owner slot `slot` called a rod (docs/rod-from-god.md) on map cell `cell`, landing at round time `land`; `seat` is `net::wire::NO_SEAT` for an enemy's. Logged after its `Fired`, in the same tick.

events.name: RodImpact
events.doc: The rod `id` landed on map cell `cell`: it left a crater (`crater`) and set a volcano off (`erupted`). What it crushed, shoved and broke follows as the ordinary events.

events.name: WellAnchored
events.doc: The orb `id` of the tank in owner slot `slot` anchored at (`x`, `y`) - by its shooter's press, on what it met, or at its range (docs/gravity-well.md): a forming well stands there with its id. `seat` is `net::wire::NO_SEAT` for an enemy's.

events.name: WellCollapsed
events.doc: The well `id` collapsed at (`x`, `y`) - `early` when an EMP's ring called it. What it flung, hurt and set off follows as the ordinary events.

events.name: Swallowed
events.doc: A shot, an orb, a missile or a drone reached a well's core at (`x`, `y`) and was swallowed: no hit, no burst.

events.name: OrbFizzled
events.doc: The orb `id` was put out in flight by an EMP's ring at (`x`, `y`): no well.

events.name: Wreck
events.doc: A tank became a wreck (any cause) at (`x`, `y`).

events.name: Ram
events.doc: Ram contact between the tanks in `slot` and `other_slot`: an enemy and a player, two enemies, or the two players. The lower-numbered party is always `slot`.  `damage` is the **roll**, not necessarily what landed. Both parties are put through `Tank::take_damage`, so a shielded one absorbs its share into `shield_hp` and its hull takes nothing. One `f32` cannot express two different applied amounts, and the two parties genuinely can differ now that the shield is a pool, so this reports the shared input rather than pretending to report an outcome. Sum it for "how hard the pack is shoving itself", never for "damage dealt".
events.fx: slam on both hulls + flash (damage roll stands in for the impulse on a replica) (fx.rs:1018-1037)

events.name: PickupCollected
events.doc: `slot` took a `kind` pickup at (`x`, `y`) - where its opening plays (`fx::CrateOpen`). `spilled`: it was a broken crate's contents lying loose (`Pickup::loose`), so there was no crate left to open.

events.name: CrateBroken
events.doc: A `kind` crate at (`x`, `y`) broke under a blast or fire (`crate_breakable`, `simulation::crates`): `cooked`, its contents went off in a blast of their own; otherwise they spilled and lie there loose.
events.fx: cooked: Oil explosion at barrel_shock*crate_cookoff_scale; CrateOpen(Broken); wood dust (fx.rs:924-934)

events.name: PickupRespawned
events.fx_elsewhere: nothing - the crate just appears; no arrow, no minimap mark

events.name: Deflected
events.doc: A projectile bounced off `slot`'s rainbow shield at (`x`, `y`).

events.name: Ricochet
events.doc: `slot`'s shot bounced off terrain at (`x`, `y`) - a shell off iron (`Projectile::try_ricochet`) or a shell or bullet off a barrel (`Material::deflect_chance`) - and flies on along `heading` (degrees, 0 = up). Recorded so a client that sees only positions knows why the shot turned.

events.name: ShieldBroken
events.doc: `slot`'s rainbow shield ran out of charge and shattered at (`x`, `y`) - the frame it crossed zero, emitted once.

events.name: ShellsCollided
events.doc: Two opposing shells met mid-air and cancelled at (`x`, `y`).

events.name: BongBite
events.doc: The `side` bong bit the tank in `slot`.
events.fx_elsewhere: bong bite animation; feedback hurt (damage diff); hit arc indicators.rs:970

events.name: BongHealed
events.doc: A bong health pack healed the `side` bong by `amount`, at the bong's own position (`x`, `y`) - which is generally nowhere near the pickup, so `fx.rs` needs the coordinates rather than deriving them from the collector. `slot` is the tank that took the pack; `None` when the bong took it itself (`BongTookPack`).

events.name: BongTookPack
events.doc: The `side` bong took the bong health pack at (`x`, `y`) itself - where its opening plays, the symbol flying into the bong (`fx::CrateOpen`).

events.name: WaveStarted
events.doc: The wave scheduler called wave `wave` (1-based): `size` tanks of `tier` queued to roll in.

events.name: TankEntered
events.doc: A wave tank in `slot` finished rolling in: it now has a body and an `Ai`, and counts as an enemy on the field.
events.fx_elsewhere: gate flash indicators.rs:990; camera cut follow.rs:1076

events.name: Rerolled
events.doc: A field map took the straggler in `slot` off the field at (`x`, `y`), out of every seat's sight, to roll it in again through a gate nearer the fight (`Game::reroll_stragglers`); its `TankEntered` follows when it is through. Not sent: a replica sees the hull leave and come back through the gate by itself.

events.name: StragglersCalled
events.doc: The round's last `count` enemies, out of touch with the fight for `straggler_call_after_seconds`, were called to the nearest live seat (`Game::straggler_phase`). Not sent: a replica sees them come.

events.name: WreckRemoved
events.doc: A wave round removed the wreck in `slot` after `wave_wreck_despawn_seconds`.

events.name: ObstacleDestroyed
events.doc: A destructible tile (wall or prop) died at (`x`, `y`), whatever destroyed it.
events.fx: tile_death by Material: Collapse or Ash impact, chips/dust (masonry, iron, volcano, door), glass+sparks (glass, lamp), timber+embers (wood, fence, target, snag), sand (sandbag), sparks+smoke (barrel), leaves+timber (trees), plate+sparks+smoke (towers) (fx.rs:935, 675-726)

events.name: ChunksBroken
events.doc: Chunks of the chunked tile (`chunks.rs`) of `material`/`variant` centred at (`x`, `y`) broke: `broken` has bit `i` for chunk `i`. The blow travelled along (`dx`, `dy`) (zero when it had no way); `collapsed` when the tile gave way and these are what it dropped. Its `ObstacleDestroyed` follows on a collapse. Only the pieces they throw (`fx.rs`) read it; the chunks' state travels with the tile.

events.name: ChunksCharred
events.doc: The fire of the burning plank wall centred at (`x`, `y`) charred through the chunks in `broken` (`Obstacle::char_chunks`): they fall in as ash. Only `fx.rs` reads it; the chunks travel with the tile.

events.name: EmberFlew
events.doc: A burning tile at (`x`, `y`) threw an ember downwind that lands at (`to_x`, `to_y`) `ember_flight_seconds` later, where it may light the wood it falls on (an `Ignited` then).

events.name: GrassTrampled
events.doc: Hulls drove into the tall-grass (or bush, or reed) cell `cell` `grass_trample_passes` times: it hides nobody for the rest of the round and its tufts lie flat (`simulation::trample`).

events.name: Blast
events.doc: A barrel detonated at (`x`, `y`); `chained` when another blast's fuse (or a fire) set it off rather than a shot or a ram; `drum` says which kind went off.
events.fx: [Hit (cause |Lava|Fire|Slime)] nothing (the world's own events draw it) (fx.rs:950); explosion by Drum (Oil/Lava/Fuel), half size when chained (fx.rs:993-1000)

events.name: DrumLaunched
events.doc: A drum launched from (`x`, `y`) toward (`to_x`, `to_y`), where it will detonate when it lands: a fuel drum another blast set off, or any drum a sonic hammer's wave threw.

events.name: LanternSet
events.doc: Seat `seat` set a lantern down at (`x`, `y`) (docs/volcano.md).

events.name: LanternBroken
events.doc: A blast broke the lantern at (`x`, `y`).

events.name: LavaBombLaunched
events.doc: An erupting volcano threw a lava bomb from its crater at (`x`, `y`) toward (`to_x`, `to_y`), where it will burst when it lands (docs/volcano.md).
events.fx: molten drops + ash at the rim (fx.rs:1064-1067)

events.name: Teleported
events.doc: `slot`'s tank entered the portal at (`x`, `y`) and was placed at (`to_x`, `to_y`), beside another portal (`Game::portal_phase`).
events.fx: blue flare out, softer flare + motes in (fx.rs:1047-1051)

events.name: ShotTeleported
events.doc: A shot or a laser beam went into a portal at (`x`, `y`) - the point of its path nearest the anchor - and came out of another at (`to_x`, `to_y`), on the same heading (`simulation::portals`, docs/teleporting.md). `id` is the projectile's (`Shell::id`), `None` for a beam, whose legs are its `LaserBeam`s.
events.fx: small blue sparks in and out (fx.rs:1057-1061)

events.name: FireStarted
events.doc: A ground cell centred on (`x`, `y`) caught fire: an oil drum's pool (`pool`) or a lit trail cell.

events.name: Ignited
events.doc: The flamethrower's stream lit something at (`x`, `y`) after `flame_ignite_seconds` of exposure (`what`: `ground`, `oil`, `wood`, `tree`, `drum`), or collapsed a prop under sustained heat (`sandbag`, `fence`).

events.name: OilPrinted
events.doc: A hull carrying oil out of a pool printed grid cell `cell`, going `dir` (`Dir::name`) with `fade` eighths of its oil left (`simulation::oil`): the cell is an oil-trail cell from now on.

events.name: MissileLocked
events.doc: A seeker missile fired by `slot` finished its climb and locked on: onto the tank in `target` slot, or - `None` - onto the ground point its launcher was aimed at, since nothing was in `missile_seek_range`.

events.name: MissileBlast
events.doc: A seeker missile fired by `slot` came down and burst at (`x`, `y`).

events.name: GrenadeBlast
events.doc: A grenade launched by `slot` went off at (`x`, `y`), its fuse spent.

events.name: CookOff
events.doc: A delayed secondary pop from a wreck's ammo cooking off. Purely cosmetic - it deals no damage - but recorded so tooling and the presentation layer can see it.

events.name: TeslaStrike
events.doc: A tesla coil's bolt, from its terminal at (`x0`, `y0`) to the tank it struck at (`x1`, `y1`); `chained` for a jump on from the first target (docs/defence-towers-prd.md section 4). The strike itself is the `Hit` that follows.
events.fx: Tesla impact + violet sparks at both ends (fx.rs:1204-1209)

events.name: TowerFired
events.doc: A tower fired from its muzzle at (`x`, `y`) along `heading`: a gun tower's burst began, or a bio slush lobbed a glob (`kind`: `gun_tower`, `bio_slush`).

events.name: GlobSplashed
events.doc: A glob of ooze landed at (`x`, `y`) and splashed.

events.name: Slimed
events.doc: Tank `slot` was coated in ooze, by a splash or a puddle. A coat on a tank already coated refreshes it without an event.

events.name: SlimeWashed
events.doc: Tank `slot` drove into water and washed its ooze off.

events.name: TowerRepaired
events.doc: A tower pack restored the `side` tower at (`x`, `y`) to full health and put it out.

events.name: BeatDone
events.doc: A training beat (1-based) was done (docs/training-stage.md).
events.fx_elsewhere: training render; bubble reads training_status, not these events (not sent)

events.name: DoorOpened
events.doc: A training door of beat `beat` opened at (`x`, `y`): its cell is open ground from now on.
events.fx_elsewhere: training render; bubble reads training_status, not these events (not sent)

events.name: FlagTaken
events.doc: Seat `seat` took the training flag at (`x`, `y`).
events.fx_elsewhere: training render; bubble reads training_status, not these events (not sent)

events.name: BongRevived
events.doc: A training round's fallen bong got up again at (`x`, `y`), and the beat it fell in starts over.
events.fx_elsewhere: training render; bubble reads training_status, not these events (not sent)

events.name: PhysicsQuarantine
events.doc: Rapier quarantined `bodies` bodies and `colliders` colliders on one fixed step because their state went non-finite (see `Physics::quarantined`). A solver blow-up, never normal play - the probe counts it as an `invariant` anomaly.
events.no_sound: A physics solver blow-up, logged as an invariant anomaly. Never normal play.

events.name: AiAction
events.doc: The behaviour tree settled on a different action than last frame.

events.name: EngageSlot
events.doc: The engagement ring gave `slot` a different slot index (see `engage::EngageSlot::index`; `None` = steering at its target - the player, or a hunter's bong - directly).
events.no_sound: AI trace only: the engagement ring changed a tank's slot. Not a moment a player perceives.

events.name: StuckEscape
events.doc: The stuck escape fired (`escapes` so far this round).
events.no_sound: AI trace only: a stuck enemy's escape fired. Its motion is heard through the engine and treads.

events.name: Breach
events.doc: A breach started toward `dir`, or ended (`None`).

events.name: Retreat
events.doc: The ammo retreat latched (`on`) or released.

events.name: Alert
events.doc: The shared last-known player position appeared or expired; `x`/`y` is the position (the last known one when `on` is false).

events.name: Retarget
events.doc: Rounds with more than one seat: the enemy in `slot` switched to fighting `player` (`Ai::target_player`).
